++#!/usr/bin/env python3
++"""Question Bank Health report (review item #35).
++
++Runs on every CI build and locally (python3 tool/bank_health.py).
++Checks the bundled bank the way a shipping guard should:
++
++  * totals per file / type
++  * missing or out-of-range answer keys
++  * duplicate ids
++  * duplicate question stems (exact, normalized)
++  * invalid options (not 4, not distinct, empty)
++  * empty explanations
++  * subject/chapter distribution (so a lost chapter stands out)
++
++Exit code 0 = bank is healthy (warnings allowed), 1 = hard problems.
++"""
++import json
++import os
++import re
++import sys
++import collections
++
++ROOT = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..")
++QDIR = os.path.join(ROOT, "assets", "questions")
++
++HARD = []
++WARN = []
++
++
++def norm(s: str) -> str:
++    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", (s or "")).strip().lower()
++
++
++def main() -> int:
++    manifest = json.load(open(os.path.join(QDIR, "manifest.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
++    files = manifest["files"]
++    if not os.path.isdir(QDIR):
++        print("bank directory missing:", QDIR)
++        return 1
++
++    by_id = collections.Counter()
++    by_stem = collections.Counter()
++    total = 0
++    per_file = collections.Counter()
++    per_type = collections.Counter()
++    dist = collections.Counter()
++    empty_chapters = []
++
++    for name in files:
++        path = os.path.join(QDIR, name)
++        rows = json.load(open(path, encoding="utf-8"))
++        per_file[name] = len(rows)
++        for r in rows:
++            total += 1
++            t = r.get("type")
++            per_type[t] += 1
++            qid = r.get("id")
++            by_id[qid] += 1
++            payload = r.get("payload") or {}
++            if t == "mcq":
++                opts = payload.get("options") or []
++                key = payload.get("correctIndex")
++                stem = norm(payload.get("questionText"))
++                by_stem[(r.get("subjectId"), t, stem)] += 1
++                if not stem:
++                    HARD.append(f"{qid}: empty question text")
++                if len(opts) != 4:
++                    HARD.append(f"{qid}: {len(opts)} options (expected 4)")
++                elif len(set(norm(o) for o in opts)) != 4:
++                    HARD.append(f"{qid}: options not distinct")
++                if any(norm(o) == "" for o in opts):
++                    HARD.append(f"{qid}: empty option")
++                if not isinstance(key, int) or not (0 <= key < len(opts)):
++                    HARD.append(f"{qid}: invalid correctIndex {key!r}")
++                elif not norm(opts[key]):
++                    HARD.append(f"{qid}: correct option is empty")
++                if norm(payload.get("explanation")) == "":
++                    WARN.append(f"{qid}: empty explanation")
++                dist[(r.get("subjectId"), r.get("chapter"), t)] += 1
++            else:
++                stem = norm(payload.get("questionText") or payload.get("stem"))
++                by_stem[(r.get("subjectId"), t, stem)] += 1
++                if not stem:
++                    HARD.append(f"{qid}: empty question text")
++                if t == "saq":
++                    if norm(payload.get("answer")) == "":
++                        HARD.append(f"{qid}: empty answer")
++                    if norm(payload.get("explanation")) == "":
++                        WARN.append(f"{qid}: empty explanation")
++                if t == "cq":
++                    # The bank legitimately ships two CQ shapes (both
++                    # rendered by paper_pdf.dart, both covered by the
++                    # guard tests): math "solution-check" questions are
++                    # three-part (ক খ গ, marks 2-4-4, no ঘ) and the
++                    # classic creative question is four-part (1-2-3-4).
++                    # Check internal consistency instead of one shape.
++                    for k in ("questionK", "questionKh", "questionG"):
++                        if norm(payload.get(k)) == "":
++                            HARD.append(f"{qid}: empty {k}")
++                    gh = norm(payload.get("questionGh")) != ""
++                    marks = payload.get("marks")
++                    if gh:
++                        if marks != [1, 2, 3, 4]:
++                            HARD.append(f"{qid}: 4 parts but marks {marks!r}")
++                    else:
++                        if marks != [2, 4, 4]:
++                            HARD.append(f"{qid}: 3 parts but marks {marks!r}")
++            ch = r.get("chapter")
++            if not ch:
++                HARD.append(f"{qid}: missing chapter")
++
++    for qid, n in by_id.items():
++        if n > 1:
++            HARD.append(f"duplicate id: {qid} (x{n})")
++    for (sub, t, stem), n in by_stem.items():
++        if n > 1 and stem:
++            WARN.append(f"duplicate stem ({sub}, {t}): {stem[:60]!r} (x{n})")
++
++    # chapter distribution (per subject, MCQs) — a dropped chapter shows up
++    print("Question Bank Health")
++    print("====================")
++    print(f"total questions: {total}")
++    for t in sorted(per_type):
++        print(f"  {t}: {per_type[t]}")
++    print("\nper file:")
++    for name in files:
++        want = manifest.get("counts", {}).get(name)
++        got = per_file[name]
++        flag = "" if want in (None, got) else f"  <-- manifest says {want}"
++        print(f"  {name}: {got}{flag}")
++    if manifest.get("total") != total:
++        HARD.append(f"manifest total {manifest.get('total')} != actual {total}")
++
++    print("\nsubject / chapter (MCQs):")
++    by_sub_ch = collections.Counter()
++    for (sub, ch, t), n in dist.items():
++        if t == "mcq" and ch:
++            by_sub_ch[(sub, ch)] += n
++    for (sub, ch), n in sorted(by_sub_ch.items(), key=lambda kv: (kv[0][0] or "", kv[0][1] or "")):
++        print(f"  {sub} :: {ch}: {n}")
++
++    print()
++    if WARN:
++        print(f"warnings ({len(WARN)}):")
++        for w in WARN[:50]:
++            print("  -", w)
++        if len(WARN) > 50:
++            print(f"  ... and {len(WARN) - 50} more")
++    if HARD:
++        print(f"\nPROBLEMS ({len(HARD)}):")
++        for h in HARD[:80]:
++            print("  !", h)
++        if len(HARD) > 80:
++            print(f"  ... and {len(HARD) - 80} more")
++        print("\nBANK UNHEALTHY")
++        return 1
++    print("bank healthy ✓" + (f" ({len(WARN)} warnings)" if WARN else ""))
++    return 0
++
++
++if __name__ == "__main__":
++    sys.exit(main())
+-- 
+2.39.5

+<script>const ALLFILES = "===== FILE: supabase/migrations/20260923000001_harden_profiles.sql =====\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n-- Tutor's Desk — Phase 1 security hardening: profiles entitlement lock\n--\n-- Run in the Supabase SQL editor (safe to run twice):\n--   https://supabase.com/dashboard/project/vxexidxdoghdmzvkvgqk/sql/new\n--\n-- What this does\n--   1. Enables RLS on public.profiles (if not already).\n--   2. DROPS every existing policy on profiles — whatever is there today\n--      (including any permissive one) is replaced by the minimal set:\n--        - a tutor may READ their own row\n--        - a tutor may UPDATE their own row (name, phone, …)\n--        - a tutor may INSERT their own row on first sign-in\n--      No policy lets anyone read or touch another tutor's row.\n--   3. Adds a trigger that FREEZES the entitlement columns\n--      (is_pro, pro_until, pro_plan) for any write made with a user\n--      token — even one's own row. The app client can no longer flip\n--      itself to Pro, and a modified app cannot either.\n--\n-- Why Pro still works\n--   The bKash edge function verifies the payment with bKash, then writes\n--   the entitlement using the SERVICE ROLE key. Service-role writes run\n--   without a user context (auth.uid() IS NULL), so the trigger leaves\n--   them alone and RLS is bypassed by design for the service role.\n--   That is the only path that may change Pro — exactly what we want.\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nalter table public.profiles enable row level security;\n\n-- ── 1. Wipe whatever policies exist today ─────────────────────────────\ndo $$\ndeclare\n  p record;\nbegin\n  for p in\n    select polname\n    from pg_policies\n    where schemaname = 'public' and tablename = 'profiles'\n  loop\n    execute format('drop policy if exists %I on public.profiles', p.polname);\n  end loop;\nend $$;\n\n-- ── 2. Minimal own-row policies ───────────────────────────────────────\ncreate policy profiles_select_own on public.profiles\n  for select to authenticated\n  using (id = auth.uid());\n\ncreate policy profiles_insert_own on public.profiles\n  for insert to authenticated\n  with check (id = auth.uid());\n\ncreate policy profiles_update_own on public.profiles\n  for update to authenticated\n  using (id = auth.uid())\n  with check (id = auth.uid());\n\n-- ── 3. Entitlement freeze for user-context writes ─────────────────────\n-- Runs BEFORE every INSERT/UPDATE. A write made through the service\n-- role has no user context (auth.uid() IS NULL) and passes untouched.\ncreate or replace function public.protect_pro_entitlements()\nreturns trigger\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity definer\nset search_path = public\nas $$\nbegin\n  if auth.uid() is not null then\n    if tg_op = 'INSERT' then\n      new.is_pro := false;\n      new.pro_until := null;\n      new.pro_plan := null;\n    elsif tg_op = 'UPDATE' then\n      if (new.is_pro is distinct from old.is_pro)\n          or (new.pro_until is distinct from old.pro_until)\n          or (new.pro_plan is distinct from old.pro_plan) then\n        new.is_pro := old.is_pro;\n        new.pro_until := old.pro_until;\n        new.pro_plan := old.pro_plan;\n      end if;\n    end if;\n  end if;\n  return new;\nend $$;\n\ndrop trigger if exists profiles_protect_pro on public.profiles;\ncreate trigger profiles_protect_pro\n  before insert or update on public.profiles\n  for each row execute function public.protect_pro_entitlements();\n\n-- ── 4. Sanity: nobody except the service role should have bypass ──────\n-- (informational — the audit script reports this too)\n-- The postgres/service_role roles are managed by Supabase itself.\n\n\n\n===== FILE: supabase/audit_rls.sql =====\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n-- Tutor's Desk — RLS audit (READ-ONLY, safe to run any time)\n--\n-- Run in the SQL editor, copy the output and share it. It reports:\n--   1. every table + whether RLS is enabled\n--   2. every policy on the security-sensitive tables\n--   3. who the question admins are\n--   4. roles that bypass RLS (only Supabase's own should appear)\n-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n\\pset pager off\n\nselect '── 1. tables & RLS status' as section;\nselect tablename,\n       rowsecurity as rls_enabled,\n       (select count(*) from pg_policies p\n         where p.schemaname = 'public' and p.tablename = t.tablename) as policy_count\nfrom pg_tables t\nwhere schemaname = 'public'\norder by tablename;\n\nselect '── 2. policies on security-sensitive tables' as section;\nselect tablename, policyname, permissive, roles::text as role_names,\n       cmd, coalesce(qual, with_check)::text as using_or_check\nfrom pg_policies\nwhere schemaname = 'public'\n  and tablename in ('profiles', 'questions', 'question_admins')\norder by tablename, policyname;\n\nselect '── storage policies (question-figures bucket)' as section;\nselect tablename, policyname, permissive, roles::text as role_names,\n       cmd, coalesce(qual, with_check)::text as using_or_check\nfrom pg_policies\nwhere schemaname = 'storage'\norder by tablename, policyname;\n\nselect '── 3. question admins (who can publish official questions)' as section;\nselect a.user_id, a.note, u.email\nfrom public.question_admins a\nleft join auth.users u on u.id = a.user_id;\n\nselect '── 4. roles that bypass RLS (should be Supabase-managed only)' as section;\nselect rolname, rolsuper, rolbypassrls, rolcanlogin\nfrom pg_roles\nwhere rolbypassrls or rolsuper\norder by rolname;\n\nselect '── 5. Answer exam-ready, in the board's style.\";\n\nfunction corsHeaders(): Record<string, string> {\n  return {\n    \"Access-Control-Allow-Origin\": \"*\",\n    \"Access-Control-Allow-Headers\":\n      \"authorization, x-client-info, apikey, content-type\",\n    \"Access-Control-Allow-Methods\": \"POST, OPTIONS\",\n  };\n}\n\nfunction fail(error: string, status = 400, code = \"ERROR\"): Response {\n  return new Response(\n    JSON.stringify({ ok: false, error, code }),\n    {\n      status,\n      headers: { ...corsHeaders(), \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\" },\n    },\n  );\n}\n\nconst supa = createClient(\n  Deno.env.get(\"SUPABASE_URL\") ?? lib/services/ai/question_schema_validator.dart =====\nimport '../questions_data.dart';\n\n/// One validation outcome.\n///\n/// [errors] are fatal — the question must not be shown as AI-verified.\n/// [warnings] are suspicion flags (the question may still be fine, but\n/// a teacher should look) — e.g. the explanation talks about a\n/// different option than the stored key.\nclass QuestionValidation {\n  final bool valid;\n  final List<String> errors;\n  final List<String> warnings;\n  const QuestionValidation({this.errors = const [], this.warnings = const []})\n      : valid = errors.isEmpty;\n\n  /// Merges another validation into a new one.\n  QuestionValidation merged(QuestionValidation other) =>\n      QuestionValidation(\n        errors: [...errors, ...other.errors],\n        warnings: [...warnings, ...other.warnings],\n      );\n}\n\n/// Structural + content validation for AI-generated MCQs (review items\n/// #2 and #6). Runs before any AI question reaches the UI:\n///\n///   Generate → schema validation → duplicate check → (answer check) → UI\n///\n/// The old string-slicing JSON parser is gone; whatever generates the\n/// questions must still pass through this — a model can emit malformed\n/// arrays, nested brackets, or a wrong \"correct\" index at any time.\nclass QuestionSchemaValidator {\n  QuestionSchemaValidator._();\n\n  /// Same banned patterns the bundled-bank guard tests use: no LaTeX\n  /// markup, no placeholder text, no invented board-year claims.\n  static final RegExp _banned = RegExp(\n    r'\\\\begin|\\\\frac|TODO|FIXME|lorem|placeholder|Board 20[0-9][0-9]',\n    caseSensitive: false,\n  );\n\n  /// Validates one MCQ.\n  static QuestionValidation validateMcq(Question q) {\n    final errors = <String>[];\n    final warnings = <String>[];\n\n    final stem = q.questionText.trim();\n    if (stem.isEmpty) errors.add('empty question text');\n\n    if (q.options.length != 4) {\n      errors.add('has ${q.options.length} options, expected 4');\n    }\n    final normOpts = [\n      for (final o in q.options) _norm(o),\n    ];\n    if (normOpts.toSet().length != normOpts.length) {\n      errors.add('options are not distinct');\n    }\n    for (var i = 0; i < q.options.length; i++) {\n      if (q.options[i].trim().isEmpty) errors.add('option $i is empty');\n    }\n    if (q.correctIndex < 0 || q.correctIndex >= q.options.length) {\n      errors.add('correctIndex ${q.correctIndex} out of range');\n    }\n    if (q.explanation.trim().isEmpty) {\n      errors.add('explanation is empty');\n    }\n\n    for (final text in [q.questionText, q.explanation, ...q.options]) {\n      if (_banned.hasMatch(text)) {\n        errors.add('banned content (LaTeX/placeholder): ${text.trim().substring(0, text.trim().length > 40 ? 40 : text.trim().length)}…');\n        break;\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Answer-sanity heuristic (review item #6, cheap local half): if the\n    // explanation quotes an option's wording, it should quote the\n    // correct one — not a distractor.\n    if (!errors.isEmpty) return QuestionValidation(errors: errors);\n    final exp = _norm(q.explanation);\n    if (exp.isNotEmpty) {\n      String? mentionedWrong;\n      bool mentionsCorrect = false;\n      for (var i = 0; i < normOpts.length; i++) {\n        final opt = normOpts[i];\n        if (opt.length < 8) continue; // too short to be a meaningful quote\n        final quoted = exp.contains(opt) || _sharesLongFragment(exp, opt);\n        if (!quoted) continue;\n        if (i == q.correctIndex) {\n          mentionsCorrect = true;\n        } else {\n          mentionedWrong ??= q.options[i].trim();\n        }\n      }\n      if (mentionedWrong != null && !mentionsCorrect) {\n        warnings.add(\n            'explanation appears to reference option \"${mentionedWrong.length > 40 ? '${mentionedWrong.substring(0, 40)}…' : mentionedWrong}\" instead of the stored key');\n      }\n    }\n    return QuestionValidation(errors: errors, warnings: warnings);\n  }\n\n  /// Validates a batch: per-question checks plus batch-level rules\n  /// (requested count, in-batch duplicates).\n  static List<QuestionValidation> validateBatch(List<Question> questions,\n      {int expectedCount = -1}) {\n    final out = [for (final q in questions) validateMcq(q)];\n    if (expectedCount > 0 && questions.length != expectedCount) {\n      for (var i = 0; i < out.length; i++) {\n        out[i] = out[i].merged(QuestionValidation(\n            errors:\n                ['batch has ${questions.length} questions, expected $expectedCount']));\n      }\n    }\n    final seen = <String, int>{};\n    for (var i = 0; i < questions.length; i++) {\n      final key = _norm(questions[i].questionText);\n      final first = seen[key];\n      if (first != null) {\n        out[i] = out[i].merged(QuestionValidation(\n            errors: ['duplicate of question #$${first + 1} in the same batch']));\n      } else {\n        seen[key] = i;\n      }\n    }\n    return out;\n  }\n\n  /// True when [hay] contains a word-run of [needle] at least 8 chars —\n  /// catches \"option text\" quotes that survive light rephrasing.\n  static bool _sharesLongFragment(String hay, String needle) {\n    if (needle.length < 8) return false;\n    final words = needle.split(' ').where((w) => w.length >= 8).toList();\n    for (final w in words) {\n      if (hay.contains(w)) return true;\n    }\n    // Otherwise check the first 12-char run.\n    final run = needle.length >= 12 ? needle.substring(0, 12) : needle;\n    return hay.contains(run);\n  }\n\n  static String _norm(String s) =>\n      s.toLowerCase().replaceAll(RegExp(r'\\s+'), ' ').trim();\n}\n\n\n\n===== FILE: lib/services/ai/duplicate_detector.dart =====\nimport '../questions_data.dart';\n\n/// One near-duplicate finding.\nclass DuplicateHit {\n  /// The generated question that looks like a copy.\n  final Question generated;\n  /// The bank question it resembles.\n  final Question source;\n  /// 0.0 (unrelated) … 1.0 (identical after normalization).\n  final double similarity;\n\n  const DuplicateHit(this.generated, this.source, this.similarity);\n}\n\n/// Near-duplicate detection for AI-generated questions (review item #5).\n///\n/// The prompt asking the model to \"make different questions every time\"\n/// is not enforcement. Before generated questions are accepted they are\n/// compared against the existing bank, previous AI questions and the\n/// current paper — with similarity, not just exact text equality, so\n/// \"Photosynthesis occurs mainly in…\" vs \"Where does photosynthesis\n/// primarily occur?\" is caught as effectively the same question.\nclass DuplicateDetector {\n  DuplicateDetector._();\n\n  /// Jaccard similarity over normalized word tokens (order-independent,\n  /// so rewording that keeps the words still scores high).\n  static double similarity(String a, String b) {\n    final ta = _tokens(a);\n    final tb = _tokens(b);\n    if (ta.isEmpty || tb.isEmpty) return 0;\n    final inter = ta.intersection(tb).length;\n    final uni = ta.union(tb).length;\n    return uni == 0 ? 0 : inter / uni;\n  }\n\n  /// Two questions are \"the same\" above this similarity. 0.75 catches\n  /// light rephrasing without flagging two questions that merely share\n  /// the topic's vocabulary.\n  static const double defaultThreshold = 0.75;\n\n  static bool isDuplicate(String a, String b,\n      {double threshold = defaultThreshold}) {\n    final na = _norm(a);\n    final nb = _norm(b);\n    if (na.isEmpty) return false;\n    if (na == nb) return true;\n    return similarity(na, nb) >= threshold;\n  }\n\n  /// Compares every generated question against [bank] (existing bank\n  /// rows, previous AI questions, the current paper — caller's choice).\n  /// Returns only the hits above [threshold], best match first per\n  /// generated question.\n  static List<DuplicateHit> findDuplicates(\n    List<Question> generated,\n    Iterable<Question> bank, {\n    double threshold = defaultThreshold,\n  }) {\n    final bankList = bank.toList();\n    final hits = <DuplicateHit>[];\n    for (final g in generated) {\n      Question? best;\n      var bestScore = 0.0;\n      for (final b in bankList) {\n        final s = isDuplicateFast(g.questionText, b.questionText, threshold)\n            ? similarity(g.questionText, b.questionText)\n            : 0.0;\n        if (s >= threshold && s > bestScore) {\n          bestScore = s;\n          best = b;\n        }\n      }\n      if (best != null) {\n        hits.add(DuplicateHit(g, best, bestScore));\n      }\n    }\n    return hits;\n  }\n\n  /// Cheap pre-filter before the Jaccard pass (token-count gate) —\n  /// similarity can only exceed [threshold] when the token sets overlap\n  /// a lot, which is impossible for very different lengths.\n  static bool isDuplicateFast(String a, String b, double threshold) {\n    final ta = _tokens(a);\n    final tb = _tokens(b);\n    if (ta.isEmpty || tb.isEmpty) return false;\n    final minLen = ta.length < tb.length ? ta.length : tb.length;\n    final maxLen = ta.length > tb.length ? ta.length : tb.length;\n    // max(inter) ≤ minLen; need inter/union ≥ t  ⇒  minLen/maxLen ≥ t\n    return minLen / maxLen >= threshold * 0.9;\n  }\n\n  static Set<String> _tokens(String s) =>\n      _norm(s).split(' ').where((w) => w.isNotEmpty).toSet();\n\n  static String _norm(String s) =>\n      s.toLowerCase().replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^a-z0-9\\u0980-\\u09FF]+'), ' ').trim();\n}\n\n\n\n===== FILE: test/ai_validator_test.dart =====\nimport 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';\n\nimport Until they exist, every APK is **debug-signed** (works\non your phone, but must be uninstalled before a signed build can be\ninstalled over it, and is not Play-Store ready).\n\n## One-time setup (~5 minutes, on any computer)\n\n### 1. Generate the keystore (ONLY ONCE — never lose this file)\n\n```bash\nkeytool -genkeypair -v \\\n  -keystore release.keystore \\\n  -storetype pkcs12 \\\n  -alias tutorsdesk \\\n  -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10000\n```\n\n- When asked for a \"distinguished name\", the organization can be your\n  name; the important fields are the **store password** and the alias\n  (`tutorsdesk`).\n- **Back up `release.keystore` somewhere safe** (password manager,\n  encrypted drive). If it is ever lost, you can never update the app on\n  existing phones — a new key means a fresh install for every user.\n- Do **not** commit it to the repo.\n\n### 2. Base64-encode it\n\n```bash\n# Linux / macOS\nbase64 -i release.keystore    # (macOS: base64 -i; Linux: base64 -w0)\n# Windows (PowerShell)\n[Convert]::ToBase64String([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes(\"release.keystore\"))\n```\n\nCopy the whole single line.\n\n### 3. Add the 4 secrets to the GitHub repo\n\n<https://github.com/subornokhan22-collab/SSC/settings/secrets/actions>\n\n| Secret name                  | Value                          |\n|------------------------------|--------------------------------|\n| `RELEASE_KEYSTORE_BASE64`    | the base64 line from step 2    |\n| `RELEASE_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD`  | the keystore password          |\n| `RELEASE_KEY_ALIAS`          | `tutorsdesk` (your alias)      |\n| `RELEASE_KEY_PASSWORD`       | the key password (usually the same) |\n\n### 4. Push once\n\nThe next build signs with the real key. From that point on,\n**uninstall the app once** on each phone and install the new build —\nAndroid refuses to update an app whose signature changed. Every build\nafter that updates normally.\n\n## How CI uses it\n\n`android/app/build.gradle.kts` signs release builds with `release-ci`\nwhen the keystore + password are present (restored by the workflow from\n`RELEASE_KEYSTORE_BASE64`), and falls back to debug signing otherwise —\nso local development builds keep working with nothing configured.\n\n## Also set (same Secrets page, for Phase 1 AI)\n\n| Secret / location                                   | Value            |\n|-----------------------------------------------------|------------------|\n| Supabase → Edge Functions → Secrets → `GEMINI_API_KEY` | your Gemini key |\n\n(The Supabase edge-function secrets are **not** GitHub secrets — they\nlive in <https://supabase.com/dashboard/project/vxexidxdoghdmzvkvgqk/functions>.)\n\n\n\n===== FILE: docs/HANDOFF-2026-09-23.md =====\n# Handoff — 2026-09-23 (Phase 1 of the 40-point review)\n\n## What happened\n\nThis coding session closed mid-work because **PR #5 merged into main**\n(the merge that brought the full app state — OMR, MiMi, bank repair —\ninto main). 'ₓ',\n};\n\nString _mapScript(String group, Map<String, String> map) {\n  final buf = StringBuffer();\n  for (final rune in group.runes) {\n    buf.write(map[String.fromCharCode(rune)] ?? String.fromCharCode(rune));\n  }\n  return buf.toString();\n}\n\n/// Turns the LaTeX the model sometimes emits (MgCl_2, Mg^{2+},\n/// \\rightarrow, \\text{...}) into the plain Unicode text the chat\n/// bubble can actually render: MgCl₂, Mg²⁺, →. No-op for normal text.\nString plainifyMath(String text) {\n  if (!text.contains(r'\\') && !text.contains('\\$')) return text;\n  var s = text;\n\n  // \\begin{env} ... \\end{env} -> drop the tags, keep the content.\n  s = s.replaceAll(RegExp(r'\\\\(?:begin|end)\\{[^{}]*\\}'), '');\n  s = s.replaceAll('&', ' ');\n\n  // \\text{...} / \\mathrm{...} -> the inner text (repeat for nesting).\n  for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {\n    final t = s.replaceAll(RegExp(r'\\\\(?:text|textrm|mathrm|mathbf)\\{([^{}]*)\\}'), r'\\1');\n    if (t == s) break;\n    s = t;\n  }\n  s = s.replaceAll(RegExp(r'\\\\(?:left|right)([|.(])?(?![a-zA-Z])'), r'\\1');\n\n  // \\frac{a}{b} -> (a)/(b), one level of nested braces allowed\n  for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) {\n    final t = s.replaceAll(\n        RegExp(r'\\\\frac\\{((?:[^{}]|\\{[^{}]*\\})*)\\}\\{((?:[^{}]|\\{[^{}]*\\})*)\\}'),\n        r'(\\1)/(\\2)');\n    if (t == s) break;\n    s = t;\n  }\n\n  // Named commands -> Unicode. Longest keys first so \\ne wins over\n  // \\neq, \\leftarrow over shorter prefixes, etc.\n  final cmdEntries = _latCmds.entries.toList()\n    ..sort((a, b) => b.key.length.compareTo(a.key.length));\n  for (final e in cmdEntries) {\n    s = s.replaceAll('\\\\${e.key}', e.value);\n  }\n\n  // Escapes & spacing.\n  s = s.replaceAll(RegExp(r'\\\\[,;:!]'), ' ');\n  s = s.replaceAll(r'\\%', '%');\n  s = s.replaceAll(r'\\\\', '\\n'); // math line break\n  s = s.replaceAll(r'\\$', '');\n\n  // Superscripts and subscripts.\n  s = s.replaceAllMapped(RegExp(r'\\^\\{([^{}]*)\\}'),\n      (m) => _mapScript(m.group(1)!, _supMap));\n  s = s.replaceAllMapped(RegExp(r'\\^([0-9+\\-])'),\n      (m) => _supMap[m.group(1)!] ?? m.group(1)!);\n  s = s.replaceAllMapped(RegExp(r'_\\{([^{}]*)\\}'),\n      (m) => _mapScript(m.group(1)!, _subMap));\n  s = s.replaceAllMapped(RegExp(r'_([0-9+\\-])'),\n      (m) => _subMap[m.group(1)!] ?? m.group(1)!);\n\n  // Leftovers: $ delimiters, braces, unknown commands.\n  s = s.replaceAll('\\$', '');\n  s = s.replaceAll('{', '').replaceAll('}', '');\n  s = s.replaceAllMapped(RegExp(r'\\\\([a-zA-Z]+)'), (m) {\n    final c = m.group(1)!;\n    return (c == 'quad' || c == 'qquad') ? '  ' : '';\n  });\n  s = s.replaceAll(r'\\', '');\n\n  s = s.replaceAll(RegExp(r'\\n{3,}'), '\\n\\n');\n  return s;\n}\n\n/// MiMi — the in-app AI assistant.\n///\n/// Answers and solves questions in Bangladesh Education Board style using\n/// the tutor's free Gemini API key (stored on the device). Future<void> _send() async {\n    if (_busy) return;\n    final text = _ctrl.text.trim();\n    if (text.length > kTextMaxChars) {\n      await _problem('Message too long',\n          'Your message is extends StatelessWidget {\n  final AnimationController controller;\n  final bool visible;\n  const _MimiBackdrop({required this.controller, required this.visible});\n\n  static final List<Offset> _stars = [];\n\n  @override\n  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n    if (_stars.isEmpty) {\n      final rnd = math.Random(7);\n      for (var i = 0; i < 46; i++) {\n        _stars.add(Offset(rnd.nextDouble(), rnd.nextDouble()));\n      }\n    }\n    if (!visible) {\n      return const DecoratedBox(\n          decoration: BoxDecoration(color: _mimiBg));\n    }\n    return RepaintBoundary(\n      child: ColoredBox(\n        color: _mimiBg,\n        child: AnimatedBuilder(\n          animation: controller,\n          builder: (_, __) => CustomPaint(\n              painter: _MimiScenePainter(controller.value, _stars)),\n        ),\n      ),\n    );\n  }\n}\n\nclass _MimiScenePainter extends CustomPainter {\n  final double t;\n  final List<Offset> stars;\n  _MimiScenePainter(this.t, this.stars);\n\n  void _blob(Canvas canvas, Offset c, double r, Color color) {\n    canvas.drawCircle(\n      c,\n      r,\n      Paint()\n        ..shader = ui.Gradient.radial(\n            c,\n            r,\n            [color, color.withOpacity(0)],\n            const [0.0, 1.0],\n            ui.TileMode.clamp),\n    );\n  }\n\n  @override\n  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {\n    final w = size.width, h = size.height;\n    final drift = t * 2 * math.pi;\n\n    // Aurora blobs drifting slowly.\n    _blob(canvas,\n        Offset(w * (.18 + .06 * math.sin(drift)), h * (.16 + .05 * math.cos(drift))),\n        w * .62, AppTheme.primary.withOpacity(.20));\n    _blob(canvas,\n        Offset(w * (.86 + .05 * math.cos(drift * 1.3)), h * (.58 + .07 * math.sin(drift * .8))),\n        w * .55, _mimiTeal.withOpacity(.11));\n    _blob(canvas,\n        Offset(w * (.5 + .08 * math.sin(drift * .7)), h * 1.02),\n        w * .7, i < total && i < old.length; i++) {\n        _key[i] = old[i];\n      }\n      _result = null;\n      _graded = null;\n    });\n  }\n\n  int get _keyDone => _key.where((k) => k >= 0).length;\n\n  // ── scan ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n  Future<void> _scan({bool rectified = false}) async {\n    final photo = _photoBytes;\n    if (photo == null) {\n      await _problem('No sheet to scan', 'Take a clear photo of the OMR sheet first.');\n      return;\n    }\n    if (_key.any((k) => k < 0)) {\n      await _problem('Answer key incomplete', '${_total - _keyDone} answer key question(s) still empty.');\n      return;\n    }\n    setState(() {\n      _busy = true;\n      _result = null;\n      _graded = null;\n    });\n    try {\n      final sw = Stopwatch()..start();\n      final res = await _runOmScan(photo, rectified: rectified);\n      if (!res.ok) {\n        setState(() => _busy = false);\n        if (mounted) {\n          await showProblemDialog(\n            context,\n            title: 'Could not read this OMR sheet',\n            message: res.error ?? 'Scan failed',\n            detail: 'Build $kOmrBuildNumber',\n          );\n        }\n        return;\n      }\n      final graded = OMrScanner.grade(res, _key);\n      _scanMs = sw.elapsedMilliseconds;\n      final overlay = await _buildOverlay(res, graded);\n      final rec = _recordOf(res, graded);\n      await OmrStore.addRecord(rec);\n      if (_batchMode) {\n        _batch.add(rec);\n        _batchOverlays.add(overlay);\n      }\n      if (!mounted) return;\n      setState(() {\n        _result = res;\n        _graded = graded;\n        _overlayJpg = overlay;\n        _busy = false;\n      });\n      _loadHistory();\n    } on OmDecodeException catch (e) {\n      setState(() => _busy = false);\n      if (mounted) {\n        await showProblemDialog(\n            context, title: 'Image could not be read', message: e.detail);\n      }\n    } catch (e) {\n      setState(() => _busy = false);\n      if (mounted) {\n        await showProblemDialog(\n          context,\n          title: 'Scan error',\n          message: '$e',\n          detail: 'Build $kOmrBuildNumber',\n        );\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  /// Runs the scan in a background isolate, and — if that isolate cannot\n  /// decode the image (a quirk of some Android builds; the UI isolate has\n  /// already decoded these exact bytes for the preview, so it can) —\n  /// retries the same scan on the UI isolate. A second or two of jank\n  /// in exchange for a correct result.\n  Future<OmScanResult> _runOmScan(Uint8List photo,\n      {required bool rectified}) async {\n    try {\n      return await compute(\n          omrScanIsolateEntry, OmScanRequest(photo, _total, rectified));\n    } on OmDecodeException {\n      return OMrScanner.scan(photo, total: _total, rectified: rectified);\n    }\n  }\n\n  OmScanRecord _recordOf(OmScanResult res, OmGraded g) => OmScanRecord(\n        id: 's_${DateTime.now().microsecondsSinceEpoch}',\n        date: DateTime.now(),\n        paperTitle: _titleCtrl.text.trim().isEmpty\n            ? 0,\n      );\n\n  /// Draws the verdict on top of the photo: each marked bubble gets a\n  /// filled circle in the verdict colour (green = correct, red = wrong,\n  /// orange = double-marked, grey = blank row), exactly the size of the\n  /// sheet's own printed bubble; a wrong/blank question also gets a\n  /// filled green disc on the correct option.\n  Future<Uint8List?> _buildOverlay(\n    OmScanResult res,\n    OmGraded g, {\n    Uint8List? photoBytes,\n  }) async {\n    // Batch items are scanned from their own photos, not the current\n    // _photoBytes — decode the item's bytes when given.\n    // When the scan produced an auto-cropped (rectified) sheet, prefer\n    // that: the user gets the same \"cropped sheet\" look the camera\n    // scanner gives, and markers are placed in plain page coordinates.\n    ui.Image? img;\n    bool cropped = false;\n    if (res.rectifiedJpeg != null) {\n      try {\n        final frame =\n            await (await ui.instantiateImageCodec(res.rectifiedJpeg!))\n                .getNextFrame();\n        img = frame.image;\n        cropped = true;\n      } catch (_) {\n        img = null;\n      }\n    }\n    if (img == null) {\n      if (photoBytes != null) {\n        try {\n          final frame =\n              await (await ui.instantiateImageCodec(photoBytes)).getNextFrame();\n          img = frame.image;\n        } catch (_) {\n          img = null;\n        }\n      } else {\n        img = _photoImage;\n      }\n    }\n    if (img == null) return null;\n    try {\n      const maxSide = 1500.0;\n      final s = maxSide / math.max(img.width, img.height);\n      final w = (img.width * s).round();\n      final h = (img.height * s).round();\n      // Cropped image is A4-proportioned (page space); the original\n      // photo is the work grid — the two need different display factors.\n      final k =\n          cropped ? (w / OMrGeometry.pageW) : (w / res.workWidth.toDouble());\n      final geo = OMrGeometry(_total);\n      // Marker placement: cropped mode maps page points straight to the\n      // display; photo mode runs them through the scan's homography.\n      Offset _mp(Offset pagePt) => cropped\n          ? pagePt * k\n          : OMrScanner.applyHomography(res.homography, pagePt) * k;\n      final cornerPts = cropped\n          ? [\n              OMrGeometry.markCenter(0),\n              OMrGeometry.markCenter(1),\n              OMrGeometry.markCenter(2),\n              OMrGeometry.markCenter(3),\n            ]\n          : res.photoCorners.map((c) => c.point).toList();\n\n      final rec = ui.PictureRecorder();\n      final canvas = Canvas(rec);\n      // Scale the full-resolution photo down to the canvas size. The\n      // markers below are positioned in *device* pixels with the\n      // work→display factor k, so the canvas must NOT be pre-scaled —\n      // a canvas.scale(s) here stretched every marker by s away from\n      // the top-left corner (a few percent on phone screenshots: small\n      // near the top-left, clearly visible at the bottom-right — the\n      // \"slightly off\" overlay look). drawImageRect scales the photo\n      // without scaling the coordinate system.\n      canvas.drawImageRect(\n        img,\n        Rect.fromLTWH(0, 0, img.width.toDouble(), img.height.toDouble()),\n        Rect.fromLTWH(0, 0, w.toDouble(), h.toDouble()),\n        Paint()..filterQuality = FilterQuality.medium,\n      );\n\n      final br = OMrGeometry.bubbleRadiusPx * k; // bubble radius, display px\n      final ringPaint = ui.Paint()\n        ..style = ui.PaintingStyle.stroke\n        ..strokeWidth = 3.0;\n\n      // Registration corners — the circle is sized to the corner mark\n      // itself, so it sits concentric on the printed square.\n      ringPaint.color = const Color(0xB33D5AFE);\n      for (final c in cornerPts) {\n        canvas.drawCircle(\n            c * k, OMrGeometry.markSize / 2 * k + 2, ringPaint);\n      }\n\n      for (var i = 0; i < _total; i++) {\n        final status = g.status[i];\n        final a = i < res.answers.length ? res.answers[i] : -1;\n        Color verdict;\n        switch (status) {\n          case 0:\n            verdict = const Color(0xFF12A150);\n          case 1:\n            verdict = const Color(0xFFE5484D);\n          case 3:\n            verdict = const Color(0xFFE08700);\n          default:\n            verdict = const Color(0xFF8A93A6);\n        }\n        ringPaint.color = verdict;\n        if (a >= 0) {\n          // Filled disc at exactly the printed bubble's radius — an\n          // oversized ring reads as sitting \"off\" the bubble, while a\n          // concentric, same-size fill makes any misalignment visible\n          // (and makes the verdict legible).\n          final c2 = _mp(geo.questionBubble(i + 1, a));\n          canvas.drawCircle(c2, br,\n              ui.Paint()..color = verdict.withOpacity(.35));\n          canvas.drawCircle(c2, br, ringPaint);\n        } else {\n          // blank / unread: draw a dim line across the row\n          final p0 = _mp(geo.questionBubble(i + 1, 0));\n          final p3 = _mp(geo.questionBubble(i + 1, 3));\n          final dim = ui.Paint()\n            ..style = ui.PaintingStyle.stroke\n            ..strokeWidth = 2.0\n            ..color = verdict.withOpacity(.65);\n          canvas.drawLine(p0, p3, dim);\n        }\n        // The key marker for wrong/blank answers — a filled disc at\n        // exactly the printed bubble's size, in its own green (the read\n        // answer's disc carries the verdict colour, so the two stay\n        // distinct).\n        if (status == 1 || (status == 2 && g.key[i] >= 0)) {\n          final pc = _mp(geo.questionBubble(i + 1, g.key[i]));\n          canvas.drawCircle(pc, br,\n              ui.Paint()..color = const Color(0x6612A150));\n          canvas.drawCircle(pc, br,\n              ui.Paint()\n                ..style = ui.PaintingStyle.stroke\n                ..strokeWidth = 2\n                ..color = const Color(0xCC12A150));\n        }\n      }\n\n      final picture = rec.endRecording();\n      final out = await picture.toImage(w, h);\n      final data = await out.toByteData(format: ui.ImageByteFormat.png);\n      return data?.buffer.asUint8List();\n    } catch (_) {\n      return null;\n    }\n  }\n\n  Future<void> _printScorecard() async {\n    final res = _result;\n    final g = _graded;\n    if (res == null || g +<div class="card"><h2 id="h0">supabase/migrations/20260923000001_harden_profiles.sql<br><button class="copy" onclick="copyFile(0)">Copy this file</button></h2><pre id="f0">-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+-- Tutor&#x27;s Desk — Phase 1 security hardening: profiles entitlement lock
+--
+-- Run in the Supabase SQL editor (safe to run twice):
+--   https://supabase.com/dashboard/project/vxexidxdoghdmzvkvgqk/sql/new
+--
+-- What this does
+--   1. Enables RLS on public.profiles (if not already).
+--   2. DROPS every existing policy on profiles — whatever is there today
+--      (including any permissive one) is replaced by the minimal set:
+--        - a tutor may READ their own row
+--        - a tutor may UPDATE their own row (name, phone, …)
+--        - a tutor may INSERT their own row on first sign-in
+--      No policy lets anyone read or touch another tutor&#x27;s row.
+--   3. Adds a trigger that FREEZES the entitlement columns
+--      (is_pro, pro_until, pro_plan) for any write made with a user
+--      token — even one&#x27;s own row. The app client can no longer flip
+--      itself to Pro, and a modified app cannot either.
+--
+-- Why Pro still works
+--   The bKash edge function verifies the payment with bKash, then writes
+--   the entitlement using the SERVICE ROLE key. Service-role writes run
+--   without a user context (auth.uid() IS NULL), so the trigger leaves
+--   them alone and RLS is bypassed by design for the service role.
+--   That is the only path that may change Pro — exactly what we want.
+-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+alter table public.profiles enable row level security;
+
+-- ── 1. Wipe whatever policies exist today ─────────────────────────────
+do $$
+declare
+  p record;
+begin
+  for p in
+    select polname
+    from pg_policies
+    where schemaname = &#x27;public&#x27; and tablename = &#x27;profiles&#x27;
+  loop
+    execute format(&#x27;drop policy if exists %I on public.profiles&#x27;, p.polname);
+  end loop;
+end $$;
+
+-- ── 2. Minimal own-row policies ───────────────────────────────────────
+create policy profiles_select_own on public.profiles
+  for select to authenticated
+  using (id = auth.uid());
+
+create policy profiles_insert_own on public.profiles
+  for insert to authenticated
+  with check (id = auth.uid());
+
+create policy profiles_update_own on public.profiles
+  for update to authenticated
+  using (id = auth.uid())
+  with check (id = auth.uid());
+
+-- ── 3. Entitlement freeze for user-context writes ─────────────────────
+-- Runs BEFORE every INSERT/UPDATE. A write made through the service
+-- role has no user context (auth.uid() IS NULL) and passes untouched.
+create or replace function public.protect_pro_entitlements()
+returns trigger
+language plpgsql
+security definer
+set search_path = public
+as $$
+begin
+  if auth.uid() is not null then
+    if tg_op = &#x27;INSERT&#x27; then
+      new.is_pro := false;
+      new.pro_until := null;
+      new.pro_plan := null;
+    elsif tg_op = &#x27;UPDATE&#x27; then
+      if (new.is_pro is distinct from old.is_pro)
+          or (new.pro_until is distinct from old.pro_until)
+          or (new.pro_plan is distinct from old.pro_plan) then
+        new.is_pro := old.is_pro;
+        new.pro_until := old.pro_until;
+        new.pro_plan := old.pro_plan;
+      end if;
+    end if;
+  end if;
+  return new;
+end $$;
+
+drop trigger if exists profiles_protect_pro on public.profiles;
+create trigger profiles_protect_pro
+  before insert or update on public.profiles
+  for each row execute function public.protect_pro_entitlements();
+
+-- ── 4. Sanity: nobody except the service role should have bypass ──────
+-- (informational — the audit script reports this too)
+-- The postgres/service_role roles are managed by Supabase itself.
+</pre></div>
+<div class="card"><h2 id="h1">supabase/audit_rls.sql<br><button class="copy" onclick="copyFile(1)">Copy this file</button></h2><pre id="f1">-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+-- Tutor&#x27;s Desk — RLS audit (READ-ONLY, safe to run any time)
+--
+-- Run in the SQL editor, copy the output and share it. It reports:
+--   1. every table + whether RLS is enabled
+--   2. every policy on the security-sensitive tables
+--   3. who the question admins are
+--   4. roles that bypass RLS (only Supabase&#x27;s own should appear)
+-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+\pset pager off
+
+select &#x27;── 1. tables &amp; RLS status&#x27; as section;
+select tablename,
+       rowsecurity as rls_enabled,
+       (select count(*) from pg_policies p
+         where p.schemaname = &#x27;public&#x27; and p.tablename = t.tablename) as policy_count
+from pg_tables t
+where schemaname = &#x27;public&#x27;
+order by tablename;
+
+select &#x27;── 2. policies on security-sensitive tables&#x27; as section;
+select tablename, policyname, permissive, roles::text as role_names,
+       cmd, coalesce(qual, with_check)::text as using_or_check
+from pg_policies
+where schemaname = &#x27;public&#x27;
+  and tablename in (&#x27;profiles&#x27;, &#x27;questions&#x27;, &#x27;question_admins&#x27;)
+order by tablename, policyname;
+
+select &#x27;── storage policies (question-figures bucket)&#x27; as section;
+select tablename, policyname, permissive, roles::text as role_names,
+       cmd, coalesce(qual, with_check)::text as using_or_check
+from pg_policies
+where schemaname = &#x27;storage&#x27;
+order by tablename, policyname;
+
+select &#x27;── 3. question admins (who can publish official questions)&#x27; as section;
+select a.user_id, a.note, u.email
+from public.question_admins a
+left join auth.users u on u.id = a.user_id;
+
+select &#x27;── 4. roles that bypass RLS (should be Supabase-managed only)&#x27; as section;
+select rolname, rolsuper, rolbypassrls, rolcanlogin
+from pg_roles
+where rolbypassrls or rolsuper
+order by rolname;
+
+select &#x27;── 5. Pro entitlements right now (who is Pro, until when)&#x27; as section;

+// Tutor&#x27;s Desk — MiMi AI gateway (server-side Gemini)
+//
+// The app no longer needs a per-device Gemini key for everyday use:
+//   app ──user JWT──▶ this function ──GEMINI_API_KEY──▶ Gemini
+//
+// Secrets (Supabase → Edge Functions → Secrets):
+//   GEMINI_API_KEY        your Gemini key from aistudio.google.com
+//
+// Deploy:
+//   supabase functions deploy mimi
+//   supabase secrets set GEMINI_API_KEY=...
+//
+// Contract (POST /functions/v1/mimi):
+//   { action: &quot;chat&quot;,
+//     system?: string,
+//     history?: [{ role: &quot;user&quot;|&quot;model&quot;, text: string }],
+//     text?: string,
+//     attachments?: [{ mime: string, data: base64 }] }
+//
+// Success: 200, text/event-stream — the raw Gemini alt=sse stream
+// (identical line format to the direct API, so the app reuses one
+// parser for server and device-key paths).
+// Failure: JSON { ok: false, error, code } with code one of
+//   UNAUTHORIZED · BAD_REQUEST · NOT_CONFIGURED · KEY_INVALID ·
+//   QUOTA · PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE · MODEL_UNAVAILABLE · GEMINI_ERROR
+// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

+import { createClient } from &quot;https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2.45.4&quot;;
+
+const GEMINI_BASE = &quot;https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta&quot;;
+
+// Stable flash models, best-first. Mirrors the app&#x27;s fallback list so
+// server and device-key paths degrade the same way.
+const MODELS = [
+  &quot;gemini-3.6-flash&quot;,
+  &quot;gemini-3.8-flash&quot;,
+  &quot;gemini-3.7-flash&quot;,
+  &quot;gemini-3.5-flash&quot;,
+  &quot;gemini-2.5-flash&quot;,
+];
+
+// Kept in sync with the app&#x27;s limits after resize; anything above the
+// edge-function payload budget is routed by the app to a device key.
+const MAX_BODY_BYTES = 5.5 * 1024 * 1024;
+const MAX_ATTACHMENTS = 3;
+
+const DEFAULT_SYSTEM =
+  &quot;You are MiMi, an expert SSC tutor for the Bangladesh Education Board (NCTB curriculum, SSC 2027). Answer exam-ready, in the board&#x27;s style.&quot;;
+
+function corsHeaders(): Record&lt;string, string&gt; {
+  return {
+    &quot;Access-Control-Allow-Origin&quot;: &quot;*&quot;,
+    &quot;Access-Control-Allow-Headers&quot;:
+      &quot;authorization, x-client-info, apikey, content-type&quot;,
+    &quot;Access-Control-Allow-Methods&quot;: &quot;POST, OPTIONS&quot;,
+  };
+}
+
+function fail(error: string, status = 400, code = &quot;ERROR&quot;): Response {
+  return new Response(
+    JSON.stringify({ ok: false, error, code }),
+    {
+      status,
+      headers: { ...corsHeaders(), &quot;Content-Type&quot;: &quot;application/json&quot; },
+    },
+  );
+}
+
+const supa = createClient(
+  Deno.env.get(&quot;SUPABASE_URL&quot;) ?? &quot;&quot;,
+  Deno.env.get(&quot;SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY&quot;) ?? &quot;&quot;,
+);
+
+Deno.serve(async (req: Request) =&gt; {
+  if (req.method === &quot;OPTIONS&quot;) {
+    return new Response(null, { status: 204, headers: corsHeaders() });
+  }
+  if (req.method !== &quot;POST&quot;) return fail(&quot;POST only.&quot;, 405, &quot;BAD_REQUEST&quot;);
+
+  // Never an open proxy: a signed-in Tutor&#x27;s Desk account is required.
+  const authHeader = req.headers.get(&quot;Authorization&quot;) ?? &quot;&quot;;
+  const token = authHeader.replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, &quot;&quot;);
+  if (!token) return fail(&quot;Sign in to use MiMi.&quot;, 401, &quot;UNAUTHORIZED&quot;);
+  const { data: userData, error: authError } = await supa.auth.getUser(token);
+  const user = userData?.user;
+  if (!user || authError) return fail(&quot;Sign in to use MiMi.&quot;, 401, &quot;UNAUTHORIZED&quot;);
+
+  const key = Deno.env.get(&quot;GEMINI_API_KEY&quot;) ?? &quot;&quot;;
+  if (!key) {
+    return fail(
+      &quot;The server AI key is not configured yet (GEMINI_API_KEY secret).&quot;,
+      503,
+      &quot;NOT_CONFIGURED&quot;,
+    );
+  }
+
+  if (Number(req.headers.get(&quot;Content-Length&quot;) ?? 0) &gt; MAX_BODY_BYTES) {
+    return fail(
+      &quot;The attachment is too large for one server request — use a smaller file.&quot;,
+      413,
+      &quot;PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE&quot;,
+    );
+  }
+
+  let payload: {
+    action?: string;
+    system?: string;
+    history?: Array&lt;{ role?: string; text?: string }&gt;;
+    text?: string;
+    attachments?: Array&lt;{ mime?: string; data?: string }&gt;;
+  };
+  try {
+    payload = await req.json();
+  } catch (_) {
+    return fail(&quot;Invalid JSON body.&quot;, 400, &quot;BAD_REQUEST&quot;);
+  }
+  if (payload.action !== &quot;chat&quot;) return fail(&quot;Unknown action.&quot;, 400, &quot;BAD_REQUEST&quot;);
+
+  const attachments = Array.isArray(payload.attachments)
+    ? payload.attachments
+    : [];
+  if (attachments.length &gt; MAX_ATTACHMENTS) {
+    return fail(`Too many attachments (max ${MAX_ATTACHMENTS}).`, 400, &quot;BAD_REQUEST&quot;);
+  }
+
+  const parts: Array&lt;Record&lt;string, unknown&gt;&gt; = [];
+  for (const a of attachments) {
+    const data = a?.data;
+    const mime = a?.mime;
+    if (typeof data !== &quot;string&quot; || data.length === 0 ||
+        typeof mime !== &quot;string&quot; || mime.length === 0) {
+      return fail(&quot;Malformed attachment.&quot;, 400, &quot;BAD_REQUEST&quot;);
+    }
+    parts.push({ inline_data: { mime_type: mime, data } });
+  }
+  const text = typeof payload.text === &quot;string&quot; ? payload.text : &quot;&quot;;
+  if (text) parts.push({ text });
+  if (parts.length === 0) return fail(&quot;Add a question or an attachment first.&quot;, 400, &quot;BAD_REQUEST&quot;);
+
+  const history = (Array.isArray(payload.history) ? payload.history : [])
+    .slice(-8)
+    .map((h) =&gt; ({
+      role: h?.role === &quot;model&quot; ? &quot;model&quot; : &quot;user&quot;,
+      text: typeof h?.text === &quot;string&quot; &amp;&amp; h.text.length &gt; 0 ? h.text : &quot; &quot;,
+    }));
+
+  const geminiBody = JSON.stringify({
+    systemInstruction: {
+      parts: [{ text: typeof payload.system === &quot;string&quot; &amp;&amp; payload.system ? payload.system : DEFAULT_SYSTEM }],
+    },
+    contents: [
+      ...history.map((h) =&gt; ({ role: h.role, parts: [{ text: h.text }] })),
+      { role: &quot;user&quot;, parts },
+    ],
+    generationConfig: { temperature: 0.4, maxOutputTokens: 8192 },
+  });
+
+  let lastMsg = &quot;No Gemini model available on the server.&quot;;
+  for (const model of MODELS) {
+    let resp: Response;
+    try {
+      resp = await fetch(
+        `${GEMINI_BASE}/models/${model}:streamGenerateContent?alt=sse&amp;key=${key}`,
+        {
+          method: &quot;POST&quot;,
+          headers: { &quot;Content-Type&quot;: &quot;application/json&quot; },
+          body: geminiBody,
+          signal: AbortSignal.timeout(180_000),
+        },
+      );
+    } catch (_) {
+      return fail(&quot;Could not reach Gemini from the server.&quot;, 502, &quot;GEMINI_ERROR&quot;);
+    }
+
+    if (resp.ok) {
+      // Pass the SSE stream straight through — same wire format as the
+      // direct API, so the app parses it with one code path.
+      return new Response(resp.body, {
+        status: 200,
+        headers: { &quot;Content-Type&quot;: &quot;text/event-stream&quot;, ...corsHeaders() },
+      });
+    }
+
+    let msg = `Gemini error (code ${resp.status}).`;
+    try {
+      const j = JSON.parse(await resp.text()) as { error?: { message?: string } };
+      if (j.error?.message) msg = j.error.message.split(&quot;\n&quot;)[0].trim();
+    } catch (_) {}
+
+    const code =
+      resp.status === 404 || /not found/i.test(msg)
+        ? &quot;MODEL_UNAVAILABLE&quot;
+        : /API key not valid|API_KEY_INVALID/.test(msg)
+          ? &quot;KEY_INVALID&quot;
+          : /quota|RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED|limit exceeded|billing/i.test(msg)
+            ? &quot;QUOTA&quot;
+            : /PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE|too large/i.test(msg)
+              ? &quot;PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE&quot;
+              : &quot;GEMINI_ERROR&quot;;
+    lastMsg = msg;
+    if (code === &quot;MODEL_UNAVAILABLE&quot;) continue; // try the next model
+    return fail(msg, resp.status &gt;= 500 ? 502 : 400, code);
+  }
+  return fail(lastMsg, 502, &quot;MODEL_UNAVAILABLE&quot;);
+});

+<div class="card"><h2 id="h3">lib/services/gemini_client.dart<br><button class="copy" onclick="copyFile(3)">Copy this file</button></h2><pre id="f3">import &#x27;dart:async&#x27;;
+import &#x27;dart:convert&#x27;;
+import &#x27;dart:io&#x27;;
+import &#x27;dart:typed_data&#x27;;
+
+import &#x27;package:http/http.dart&#x27; as http;
+import &#x27;package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart&#x27;;
+
+import &#x27;supabase_config.dart&#x27;;
+
+/// Direct Gemini API client (REST, v1beta).
+///
+/// One call takes the conversation history (text), the new user text and
+/// optional inline attachments — photos (image/jpeg|png|webp), audio
+/// (wav/mp3/ogg/flac/aiff) and PDFs — and streams the answer back through
+/// [onChunk] as it arrives.
+///
+/// The key is the tutor&#x27;s own free key from aistudio.google.com, stored on
+/// the device (see AiTutorScreen). If the requested model is not available
+/// for the key it automatically retries with the previous model.
+
+class GeminiException implements Exception {
+  final String message;
+  /// Fatal = a fallback to another model cannot help (bad key, quota,
+  /// safety block, network). Non-fatal errors (unknown model) trigger the
+  /// internal model fallback.
+  final bool fatal;
+  /// Machine-readable code from the server path (see the `mimi` edge
+  /// function): NOT_CONFIGURED, UNAUTHORIZED, QUOTA, KEY_INVALID,
+  /// PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, MODEL_UNAVAILABLE, GEMINI_ERROR. Null on the
+  /// device-key path.
+  final String? code;
+  const GeminiException(this.message, {this.fatal = true, this.code});
+
+  @override
+  String toString() =&gt; message;
+}
+
+class GeminiAttachment {
+  final String mimeType;
+  final Uint8List data;
+  const GeminiAttachment(this.mimeType, this.data);
+}
+
+class GeminiClient {
+  static const _apiBase = &#x27;https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta&#x27;;
+
+  /// Stable flash models, best for everyday + multimodal first.
+  static const _models = [
+    &#x27;gemini-3.6-flash&#x27;,
+    &#x27;gemini-3.8-flash&#x27;,
+    &#x27;gemini-3.7-flash&#x27;,
+    &#x27;gemini-3.5-flash&#x27;,
+    &#x27;gemini-2.5-flash&#x27;,
+  ];
+
+  static String? _discovered;
+
+  /// [history] = earlier turns, oldest first: keys &#x27;user&#x27; | &#x27;model&#x27;.
+  static Future&lt;String&gt; chat({
+    required String apiKey,
+    required String systemPrompt,
+    List&lt;Map&lt;String, String&gt;&gt; history = const [],
+    required String userText,
+    List&lt;GeminiAttachment&gt; attachments = const [],
+    void Function(String chunk)? onChunk,
+    Duration timeout = const Duration(seconds: 120),
+  }) async {
+    final parts = &lt;Map&lt;String, dynamic&gt;&gt;[
+      for (final a in attachments)
+        {
+          &#x27;inline_data&#x27;: {&#x27;mime_type&#x27;: a.mimeType, &#x27;data&#x27;: base64Encode(a.data)}
+        },
+      if (userText.isNotEmpty) {&#x27;text&#x27;: userText},
+    ];
+    if (parts.isEmpty) {
+      throw const GeminiException(&#x27;Add a question or an attachment first.&#x27;);
+    }
+    final body = jsonEncode({
+      &#x27;systemInstruction&#x27;: {&#x27;parts&#x27;: [{&#x27;text&#x27;: systemPrompt}]},
+      &#x27;contents&#x27;: [
+        for (final h in history)
+          {
+            &#x27;role&#x27;: h[&#x27;role&#x27;],
+            &#x27;parts&#x27;: [
+              {&#x27;text&#x27;: (h[&#x27;text&#x27;] ?? &#x27;&#x27;).isEmpty ? &#x27; &#x27; : h[&#x27;text&#x27;]}
+            ]
+          },
+        {
+          &#x27;role&#x27;: &#x27;user&#x27;,
+          &#x27;parts&#x27;: parts,
+        },
+      ],
+      &#x27;generationConfig&#x27;: {
+        &#x27;temperature&#x27;: 0.4,
+        &#x27;maxOutputTokens&#x27;: 8192,
+      },
+    });
+
+    // Try the model that worked last time first, then the static list,
+    // and finally whatever the API says this key can access.
+    final cached = await _cachedModel();
+    final candidates = &lt;String&gt;[
+      if (cached != null) cached,
+      ..._models,
+      if (_discovered != null &amp;&amp; _discovered != cached) _discovered!,
+    ].toSet().toList();
+
+    GeminiException? last;
+    bool onlyModelMiss = true;
+    for (final model in candidates) {
+      try {
+        final out = await _stream(model, apiKey, body, onChunk, timeout);
+        await _saveModel(model);
+        return out;
+      } on GeminiException catch (e) {
+        if (e.fatal) rethrow;
+        last = e; // model missing for this key — try the next model
+        onlyModelMiss = onlyModelMiss &amp;&amp; e.message == &#x27;Model unavailable&#x27;;
+      }
+    }
+
+    // Every static model 404&#x27;d — ask the API which models this key can use.
+    final discovered = _discovered ?? await _discoverModel(apiKey);
+    if (discovered != null &amp;&amp; !candidates.contains(discovered)) {
+      try {
+        final out =
+            await _stream(discovered, apiKey, body, onChunk, timeout);
+        await _saveModel(discovered);
+        return out;
+      } on GeminiException catch (e) {
+        if (e.fatal) rethrow;
+        last = e;
+      }
+    }
+    if (onlyModelMiss) {
+      throw const GeminiException(
+          &#x27;No Gemini model is available for this key. Check the key on aistudio.google.com and try again.&#x27;);
+    }
+    throw last ?? const GeminiException(&#x27;Gemini request failed.&#x27;);
+  }
+
+  static Future&lt;String?&gt; _cachedModel() async {
+    try {
+      final p = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
+      return p.getString(&#x27;mimi_model&#x27;);
+    } catch (_) {
+      return null;
+    }
+  }
+
+  static Future&lt;void&gt; _saveModel(String model) async {
+    try {
+      final p = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
+      await p.setString(&#x27;mimi_model&#x27;, model);
+    } catch (_) {}
+  }
+
+  /// Asks the API to list the models this key can access and returns a
+  /// suitable stable generative &quot;flash&quot; model (never lite/image/live/preview).
+  static Future&lt;String?&gt; _discoverModel(String apiKey) async {
+    if (_discovered != null) return _discovered;
+    try {
+      final client = http.Client();
+      final resp = await client
+          .get(Uri.parse(&#x27;$_apiBase/models?pageSize=200&amp;key=$apiKey&#x27;))
+          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 20));
+      client.close();
+      if (resp.statusCode != 200) return null;
+      final j = jsonDecode(resp.body) as Map&lt;String, dynamic&gt;;
+      final models = j[&#x27;models&#x27;];
+      if (models is! List) return null;
+      final ids = &lt;String&gt;[
+        for (final m in models)
+          if (m is Map &amp;&amp; m[&#x27;name&#x27;] is String)
+            (m[&#x27;name&#x27;] as String).replaceFirst(&#x27;models/&#x27;, &#x27;&#x27;),
+      ];
+      String? best;
+      for (final w in _models) {
+        if (ids.contains(w)) {
+          best = w;
+          break;
+        }
+      }
+      if (best == null) {
+        for (final id in ids) {
+          if (id.contains(&#x27;flash&#x27;) &amp;&amp;
+              !id.contains(&#x27;lite&#x27;) &amp;&amp;
+              !id.contains(&#x27;image&#x27;) &amp;&amp;
+              !id.contains(&#x27;live&#x27;) &amp;&amp;
+              !id.contains(&#x27;preview&#x27;) &amp;&amp;
+              !id.contains(&#x27;transcribe&#x27;)) {
+            best = id;
+            break;
+          }
+        }
+      }
+      if (best != null) _discovered = best;
+      return best;
+    } catch (_) {
+      return null;
+    }
+  }
+
+
+  static Future&lt;String&gt; _stream(String model, String apiKey, String bodyJson,
+      void Function(String chunk)? onChunk, Duration timeout) async {
+    final req = http.Request(
+        &#x27;POST&#x27;,
+        Uri.parse(
+            &#x27;$_apiBase/models/$model:streamGenerateContent?alt=sse&amp;key=$apiKey&#x27;))
+      ..headers[&#x27;Content-Type&#x27;] = &#x27;application/json&#x27;
+      ..body = bodyJson;
+    final client = http.Client();
+    try {
+      final resp = await client.send(req).timeout(timeout);
+      if (resp.statusCode != 200) {
+        throw await _errorOf(resp, model);
+      }
+      return await _readSse(resp, onChunk);
+    } on http.ClientException catch (e) {
+      throw GeminiException(&#x27;Network error while contacting Gemini: ${e.message}&#x27;);
+    } on SocketException catch (e) {
+      throw GeminiException(&#x27;Network error: ${e.message}&#x27;);
+    } on TimeoutException {
+      throw const GeminiException(
+          &#x27;Gemini took too long to answer. Try a shorter question or a smaller attachment.&#x27;);
+    } finally {
+      client.close();
+    }
+  }
+
+  /// Reads a Gemini alt=sse stream to completion, forwarding each text
+  /// chunk to [onChunk] and returning the full answer. Shared by the
+  /// device-key path and the server (edge function) path — both speak
+  /// the identical wire format.
+  static Future&lt;String&gt; _readSse(
+      http.StreamedResponse resp, void Function(String chunk)? onChunk) async {
+    final out = StringBuffer();
+    var gotAny = false;
+    await for (final line
+        in resp.stream.transform(utf8.decoder).transform(const LineSplitter())) {
+      if (!line.startsWith(&#x27;data:&#x27;)) continue;
+      final payload = line.substring(5).trim();
+      if (payload.isEmpty || payload == &#x27;[DONE]&#x27;) continue;
+      final Map&lt;String, dynamic&gt; j;
+      try {
+        j = jsonDecode(payload) as Map&lt;String, dynamic&gt;;
+      } catch (_) {
+        continue; // partial/garbled keep-alive line
+      }
+      final pf = j[&#x27;promptFeedback&#x27;];
+      if (pf is Map &amp;&amp; (pf[&#x27;blockReason&#x27;] as String?)?.isNotEmpty == true) {
+        throw const GeminiException(
+            &#x27;Google\&#x27;s safety filter blocked this question — rephrase it and try again.&#x27;);
+      }
+      final candidates = j[&#x27;candidates&#x27;];
+      if (candidates is List &amp;&amp; candidates.isNotEmpty) {
+        final content = (candidates.first as Map&lt;String, dynamic&gt;)[&#x27;content&#x27;];
+        final ps = (content is Map&lt;String, dynamic&gt;) ? content[&#x27;parts&#x27;] : null;
+        if (ps is List) {
+          for (final p in ps) {
+            if (p is Map&lt;String, dynamic&gt; &amp;&amp; p[&#x27;text&#x27;] is String) {
+              gotAny = true;
+              out.write(p[&#x27;text&#x27;]);
+              onChunk?.call(p[&#x27;text&#x27;] as String);
+            }
+          }
+        }
+      }
+    }
+    if (!gotAny) {
+      throw const GeminiException(
+          &#x27;Gemini returned an empty answer — try once more.&#x27;);
+    }
+    return out.toString();
+  }
+
+  /// The edge function rejects bodies above 5.5 MB. Base64 inflates
+  /// binary by 4/3, so estimate the encoded size before sending.
+  static bool fitsServerPath({
+    required String userText,
+    required List&lt;GeminiAttachment&gt; attachments,
+  }) {
+    final raw = attachments.fold&lt;int&gt;(0, (s, a) =&gt; s + a.data.length);
+    final encoded = raw * 4 ~/ 3 + 4;
+    return encoded + userText.length + 1024 &lt; 5_000_000;
+  }
+
+  /// Server path — talks to the `mimi` edge function, which carries the
+  /// GEMINI_API_KEY server-side (review item #1: no per-device key for
+  /// everyday use). [accessToken] is the signed-in user&#x27;s Supabase JWT;
+  /// the function refuses anonymous callers.
+  ///
+  /// Throws [GeminiException] with [GeminiException.code] set so the
+  /// caller can route fallbacks (NOT_CONFIGURED / UNAUTHORIZED → device
+  /// key, when one is stored).
+  static Future&lt;String&gt; chatViaServer({
+    required String accessToken,
+    required String systemPrompt,
+    List&lt;Map&lt;String, String&gt;&gt; history = const [],
+    required String userText,
+    List&lt;GeminiAttachment&gt; attachments = const [],
+    void Function(String chunk)? onChunk,
+    Duration timeout = const Duration(seconds: 180),
+  }) async {
+    if (attachments.isEmpty &amp;&amp; userText.isEmpty) {
+      throw const GeminiException(&#x27;Add a question or an attachment first.&#x27;);
+    }
+    final body = &lt;String, dynamic&gt;{
+      &#x27;action&#x27;: &#x27;chat&#x27;,
+      &#x27;system&#x27;: systemPrompt,
+      &#x27;text&#x27;: userText,
+      &#x27;attachments&#x27;: [
+        for (final a in attachments)
+          {&#x27;mime&#x27;: a.mimeType, &#x27;data&#x27;: base64Encode(a.data)}
+      ],
+      &#x27;history&#x27;: [
+        for (final h in history)
+          {&#x27;role&#x27;: h[&#x27;role&#x27;], &#x27;text&#x27;: (h[&#x27;text&#x27;] ?? &#x27;&#x27;).isEmpty ? &#x27; &#x27; : h[&#x27;text&#x27;]}
+      ],
+    };
+    final req = http.Request(
+        &#x27;POST&#x27;, Uri.parse(&#x27;${SupabaseConfig.url}/functions/v1/mimi&#x27;))
+      ..headers[&#x27;Content-Type&#x27;] = &#x27;application/json&#x27;
+      ..headers[&#x27;Authorization&#x27;] = &#x27;Bearer $accessToken&#x27;
+      ..headers[&#x27;apikey&#x27;] = SupabaseConfig.anonKey
+      ..body = jsonEncode(body);
+    final client = http.Client();
+    try {
+      final resp = await client.send(req).timeout(timeout);
+      if (resp.statusCode != 200) {
+        throw await _serverErrorOf(resp);
+      }
+      return await _readSse(resp, onChunk);
+    } on http.ClientException catch (e) {
+      throw GeminiException(&#x27;Network error while contacting the AI server: ${e.message}&#x27;);
+    } on SocketException catch (e) {
+      throw GeminiException(&#x27;Network error: ${e.message}&#x27;);
+    } on TimeoutException {
+      throw const GeminiException(
+          &#x27;The AI server took too long to answer. Try a shorter question or a smaller attachment.&#x27;);
+    } finally {
+      client.close();
+    }
+  }
+
+  /// Maps a non-2xx reply from the `mimi` edge function to a
+  /// [GeminiException] carrying its machine-readable [GeminiException.code].
+  static Future&lt;GeminiException&gt; _serverErrorOf(http.StreamedResponse resp) async {
+    String text;
+    try {
+      text = await utf8.decodeStream(resp.stream);
+    } catch (_) {
+      text = &#x27;&#x27;;
+    }
+    String msg = &#x27;AI server error (code ${resp.statusCode}).&#x27;;
+    String? code;
+    try {
+      final j = jsonDecode(text) as Map&lt;String, dynamic&gt;;
+      if (j[&#x27;error&#x27;] is String) msg = (j[&#x27;error&#x27;] as String).split(&#x27;\n&#x27;).first.trim();
+      code = (j[&#x27;code&#x27;] is String) ? j[&#x27;code&#x27;] as String : null;
+    } catch (_) {}
+    if (resp.statusCode == 503 &amp;&amp; (code == null || code == &#x27;NOT_CONFIGURED&#x27;)) {
+      code = &#x27;NOT_CONFIGURED&#x27;;
+    }
+    if (resp.statusCode == 401 &amp;&amp; code == null) code = &#x27;UNAUTHORIZED&#x27;;
+    return GeminiException(msg, code: code ?? &#x27;GEMINI_ERROR&#x27;);
+  }
+
+  /// Maps a non-2xx reply to a user-facing [GeminiException].
+  static Future&lt;GeminiException&gt; _errorOf(
+      http.StreamedResponse resp, String model) async {
+    String text;
+    try {
+      text = await utf8.decodeStream(resp.stream);
+    } catch (_) {
+      text = &#x27;&#x27;;
+    }
+    String msg = &#x27;Gemini error (code ${resp.statusCode}).&#x27;;
+    try {
+      final j = jsonDecode(text) as Map&lt;String, dynamic&gt;;
+      final e = j[&#x27;error&#x27;];
+      if (e is Map &amp;&amp; e[&#x27;message&#x27;] is String) {
+        msg = ((e[&#x27;message&#x27;] as String).split(&#x27;\n&#x27;).first).trim();
+      }
+    } catch (_) {}
+    // Unknown model for this key → let the caller fall back.
+    if (resp.statusCode == 404 ||
+        msg.contains(&#x27;was not found&#x27;) ||
+        msg.contains(&#x27;not found&#x27;)) {
+      return GeminiException(&#x27;Model unavailable&#x27;, fatal: false);
+    }
+    if (msg.contains(&#x27;API key not valid&#x27;) || msg.contains(&#x27;API_KEY_INVALID&#x27;)) {
+      return const GeminiException(
+          &#x27;This Gemini API key is not valid — check the key on the setup screen.&#x27;);
+    }
+    if (msg.contains(&#x27;quota&#x27;) ||
+        msg.contains(&#x27;RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED&#x27;) ||
+        msg.contains(&#x27;limit exceeded&#x27;) ||
+        msg.contains(&#x27;billing&#x27;)) {
+      return const GeminiException(
+          &#x27;Gemini usage limit reached for this key — wait a few minutes, then try again.&#x27;);
+    }
+    if (msg.contains(&#x27;PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE&#x27;) || msg.contains(&#x27;too large&#x27;)) {
+      return const GeminiException(
+          &#x27;The attachment is too large for one request — use a smaller file.&#x27;);
+    }
+    return GeminiException(msg);
+  }
+}
+
+/// System prompt — the whole &quot;board-style tutor&quot; persona lives here.
+const String kMimiSystemPrompt = &#x27;&#x27;&#x27;
+You are &quot;MiMi&quot; — an expert SSC tutor for the Bangladesh Education Board (NCTB curriculum, SSC 2027 syllabus). You help tutors with students&#x27; questions.

+/// Email + password sign-in, tutor profile (name / phone), Pro sync (Supabase).
+///
+/// Flow:
+///  1) Sign up — name, +880 phone, email + password. Supabase emails a
+///     one-time code to confirm the address, then a `profiles` row is created
+///     with role `teacher`. This is the ONLY time a code is sent.
+///  2) Sign in — email + password. No code, no email round-trip.
+///  3) If `profiles.is_pro` is true, syncing turns Pro on for this device.
+///
+/// Tutor&#x27;s Desk is a tutor-only product, so every account is a teacher account.
+/// When Supabase is not configured ([SupabaseConfig] empty) every call degrades
+/// gracefully instead of throwing, and the offline features keep working.
+class AuthService {
+  AuthService._();

+  /// Role stored for every account created by this app.

+  static bool _initialised = false;

+  static Future&lt;void&gt; init() async {
+    if (!SupabaseConfig.isConfigured) return;

+    try {
+      await Supabase.initialize(
+        url: SupabaseConfig.url,
+        anonKey: SupabaseConfig.anonKey,
+      );
+      _initialised = true;
+    } catch (_) {
+      _initialised = false;
+    }
+  }
+
+  static SupabaseClient get _c =&gt; Supabase.instance.client;

+  /// The signed-in user&#x27;s Supabase JWT — what the `mimi` edge function
+  /// (server-side AI) needs to identify the caller. Null when signed out.

+  static String _validEmail(String email) {
+    final e = email.trim();

+      throw const AuthException(&#x27;Enter a valid email address&#x27;);
+    }

+  //
+  // The verification code is only ever sent here, at sign-up. Afterwards the
+  // tutor signs in with their email + password and receives no further codes.
+  static Future&lt;void&gt; signUpWithPassword({
+    required String email,
+    required String password,
+  }) async {
+    _requireReady();
+    final e = _validEmail(email);
+    if (password.length &lt; minPasswordLength) {
+      throw AuthException(

+    final res = await _c.auth.signUp(email: e, password: password);

+    // arrives immediately and no code needs to be entered.
+    if (res.session != null) _profileCache = null;

+  /// True when sign-up returned a usable session (no email confirmation step).
+  static bool get hasSession =&gt; isLoggedIn;

+  // ── Verify the sign-up code (only used once, right after sign-up) ──
+  static Future&lt;void&gt; verifySignUpCode({
+    required String email,
+    required String code,
+  }) async {
+    _requireReady();
+    final c = code.trim();
+    if (c.isEmpty) throw const AuthException(&#x27;Enter the code from your email&#x27;);
+    final e = email.trim();

+    // Newer projects issue a `signup` token; older ones fall back to `email`.
+    try {
+      res = await _c.auth

+    }
+    if (res.session == null) {
+      throw const AuthException(&#x27;The code did not match — please try again&#x27;);

+  }

+  // ── Sign in: email + password only, never a code ──────────────────
+  static Future&lt;void&gt; signInWithPassword({
+    required String email,
+    required String password,
+  }) async {
+    _requireReady();
+    final e = _validEmail(email);
+    if (password.isEmpty) throw const AuthException(&#x27;Enter your password&#x27;);
+    final res = await _c.auth.signInWithPassword(email: e, password: password);
+    if (res.session == null) {
+      throw const AuthException(&#x27;Could not sign in — please try again&#x27;);
+    }
+    _profileCache = null;
+  }
