+  /// Sets a password on the signed-in account (used by &quot;change password&quot;).
+  static Future&lt;void&gt; setPassword(String password) async {
+    _requireReady();
+    if (password.length &lt; minPasswordLength) {
+      throw AuthException(
+          &#x27;Password must be at least $minPasswordLength characters&#x27;);
+    }
+    await _c.auth.updateUser(UserAttributes(password: password));
+  }
+
+  /// Makes sure the account carries [password], for use right after sign-up.
+  ///
+  /// `signUp` already attaches the password, so once the code is verified the
+  /// account usually has it. Supabase then rejects re-setting the same value
+  /// with &quot;New password should be different from the old password&quot; — which is
+  /// a success for our purposes, not a failure. Anything else is rethrown.
+  static Future&lt;void&gt; ensurePassword(String password) async {
+    try {
+      await setPassword(password);
+    } on AuthException catch (e) {
+      final m = e.message.toLowerCase();
+      final alreadySet = m.contains(&#x27;should be different&#x27;) ||
+          m.contains(&#x27;different from the old password&#x27;) ||
+          m.contains(&#x27;same as the old password&#x27;) ||
+          m.contains(&#x27;same_password&#x27;);
+      if (!alreadySet) rethrow;
+    }
+  }
+
+  /// Emails a password-reset link/code for tutors who forgot their password.
+  static Future&lt;void&gt; sendPasswordReset(String email) async {
+    _requireReady();
+    await _c.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(_validEmail(email));
+  }
+
+  /// Sends the sign-up confirmation code again.
+  ///
+  /// Supabase&#x27;s built-in mailer is rate limited (a handful of messages per
+  /// hour for the whole project) and drops anything over the cap without
+  /// reporting an error, so a retry is worth having.
+  static Future&lt;void&gt; resendSignUpCode(String email) async {
+    _requireReady();
+    await _c.auth.resend(type: OtpType.signup, email: _validEmail(email));
+  }
+
+  // ── Reading the profile ───────────────────────────────────────────
+  static Future&lt;Map&lt;String, dynamic&gt;?&gt; fetchProfile({bool refresh = true}) async {
+    if (!isLoggedIn) return null;
+    if (!refresh &amp;&amp; _profileCache != null) return _profileCache;
+    final u = _c.auth.currentUser;
+    if (u == null) return null;
+    try {
+      final row = await _c
+          .from(&#x27;profiles&#x27;)
+          .select()
+          .eq(&#x27;id&#x27;, u.id)
+          .maybeSingle()
+          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 6));
+      if (row != null) _profileCache = Map&lt;String, dynamic&gt;.from(row);
+      return _profileCache;
+    } catch (_) {
+      return _profileCache;
+    }
+  }
+
+  /// Creates the tutor profile row on first sign-in, filling only the blanks
+  /// on an existing row so nothing the teacher already saved is overwritten.
+  static Future&lt;Map&lt;String, dynamic&gt;&gt; ensureTeacherProfile({
+    String name = &#x27;&#x27;,
+    String phone = &#x27;&#x27;,
+  }) async {
+    final u = _c.auth.currentUser;
+    if (u == null) throw const AuthException(&#x27;You are not signed in&#x27;);
+    final existing = await fetchProfile();
+    try {
+      if (existing == null) {
+        await _c.from(&#x27;profiles&#x27;)
+            .insert({
+              &#x27;id&#x27;: u.id,
+              &#x27;email&#x27;: u.email ?? &#x27;&#x27;,
+              &#x27;role&#x27;: teacherRole,
+              &#x27;name&#x27;: name,
+              &#x27;phone&#x27;: phone,
+            })
+            .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 6));
+      } else {
+        final patch = &lt;String, dynamic&gt;{};
+        if ((existing[&#x27;name&#x27;]?.toString() ?? &#x27;&#x27;).isEmpty &amp;&amp; name.isNotEmpty) {
+          patch[&#x27;name&#x27;] = name;
+        }
+        if ((existing[&#x27;phone&#x27;]?.toString() ?? &#x27;&#x27;).isEmpty &amp;&amp; phone.isNotEmpty) {
+          patch[&#x27;phone&#x27;] = phone;
+        }
+        if ((existing[&#x27;role&#x27;]?.toString() ?? &#x27;&#x27;) != teacherRole) {
+          patch[&#x27;role&#x27;] = teacherRole;
+        }
+        if (patch.isNotEmpty) {
+          await _c.from(&#x27;profiles&#x27;)
+              .update(patch)
+              .eq(&#x27;id&#x27;, u.id)
+              .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 6));
+        }
+      }
+    } catch (_) {
+      // Offline / RLS issue — fall through to whatever we can read back.
+    }
+    final p = await fetchProfile() ??
+        &lt;String, dynamic&gt;{
+          &#x27;email&#x27;: u.email ?? &#x27;&#x27;,
+          &#x27;role&#x27;: teacherRole,
+          &#x27;name&#x27;: name,
+          &#x27;phone&#x27;: phone,
+          &#x27;is_pro&#x27;: false,
+        };
+    _profileCache = p;
+    return p;
+  }
+
+  /// Updates name / phone only — email, role and is_pro are never touched.
+  static Future&lt;void&gt; updateProfile({String? name, String? phone}) async {
+    _requireReady();
+    final u = _c.auth.currentUser;
+    if (u == null) throw const AuthException(&#x27;You are not signed in&#x27;);
+    final patch = &lt;String, dynamic&gt;{};
+    if (name != null) patch[&#x27;name&#x27;] = name.trim();
+    if (phone != null) patch[&#x27;phone&#x27;] = phone.trim();
+    if (patch.isEmpty) return;
+    await _c.from(&#x27;profiles&#x27;)
+        .update(patch)
+        .eq(&#x27;id&#x27;, u.id)
+        .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 6));
+    await fetchProfile();
+  }

+  /// Turns Pro on for this device when the server has it enabled.
+  /// Carries the subscription end date (monthly / yearly plans); a
+  /// one-time unlock leaves it null = forever.
+  static Future&lt;bool&gt; syncProFromServer() async {

+    }

+  }

+  /// Turns any auth/network failure into a short, human message.
+  static String friendlyError(Object e) {
+    final s = e.toString().toLowerCase();
+
+    // Network problems are checked BEFORE the AuthException shortcut below.
+    // supabase_flutter wraps connection failures in
+    // AuthRetryableFetchException, which extends AuthException and carries
+    // the raw socket text as its message — returning that early dumped
+    // &quot;ClientException with SocketException: Failed host lookup ...&quot; straight
+    // onto the sign-in screen.
+    if (s.contains(&#x27;socketexception&#x27;) ||
+        s.contains(&#x27;failed host lookup&#x27;) ||
+        s.contains(&#x27;no address associated&#x27;) ||
+        s.contains(&#x27;clientexception&#x27;) ||
+        s.contains(&#x27;connection closed&#x27;) ||
+        s.contains(&#x27;connection refused&#x27;) ||
+        s.contains(&#x27;connection reset&#x27;) ||
+        s.contains(&#x27;handshake&#x27;) ||
+        s.contains(&#x27;timeout&#x27;) ||
+        s.contains(&#x27;timed out&#x27;) ||
+        s.contains(&#x27;network is unreachable&#x27;)) {
+      return &#x27;Cannot reach the server — check your internet connection &#x27;
+          &#x27;(try switching between Wi-Fi and mobile data) and try again.&#x27;;
+    }
+    if (s.contains(&#x27;rate&#x27;) || s.contains(&#x27;429&#x27;) || s.contains(&#x27;too many&#x27;)) {
+      return &#x27;Too many attempts — please wait a moment and try again.&#x27;;
+    }
+    if (e is AuthException &amp;&amp; e.message.trim().isNotEmpty) return e.message;
+    if (s.contains(&#x27;invalid login credentials&#x27;) ||
+        s.contains(&#x27;invalid_credentials&#x27;)) {
+      return &#x27;Wrong email or password — please try again.&#x27;;
+    }
+    if (s.contains(&#x27;email not confirmed&#x27;)) {
+      return &#x27;Please confirm your email first, then sign in.&#x27;;
+    }
+    if (s.contains(&#x27;user already registered&#x27;) ||
+        s.contains(&#x27;already been registered&#x27;)) {
+      return &#x27;That email already has an account — sign in instead.&#x27;;
+    }
+    if (s.contains(&#x27;expired&#x27;) || s.contains(&#x27;invalid&#x27;) || s.contains(&#x27;token&#x27;)) {
+      return &#x27;That code is wrong or expired — request a new one.&#x27;;
+    }
+    return &#x27;Something went wrong — please try again.&#x27;;
+  }

+<div class="card"><h2 id="h5">lib/services/ai/question_schema_validator.dart<br><button class="copy" onclick="copyFile(5)">Copy this file</button></h2><pre id="f5">import &#x27;../questions_data.dart&#x27;;

+/// One validation outcome.
+///
+/// [errors] are fatal — the question must not be shown as AI-verified.
+/// [warnings] are suspicion flags (the question may still be fine, but
+/// a teacher should look) — e.g. the explanation talks about a
+/// different option than the stored key.
+class QuestionValidation {
+  final bool valid;
+  final List&lt;String&gt; errors;
+  final List&lt;String&gt; warnings;
+  const QuestionValidation({this.errors = const [], this.warnings = const []})
+      : valid = errors.isEmpty;
+
+  /// Merges another validation into a new one.
+  QuestionValidation merged(QuestionValidation other) =&gt;
+      QuestionValidation(
+        errors: [...errors, ...other.errors],
+        warnings: [...warnings, ...other.warnings],
+      );
+}
+
+/// Structural + content validation for AI-generated MCQs (review items
+/// #2 and #6). Runs before any AI question reaches the UI:
+///
+///   Generate → schema validation → duplicate check → (answer check) → UI
+///
+/// The old string-slicing JSON parser is gone; whatever generates the
+/// questions must still pass through this — a model can emit malformed
+/// arrays, nested brackets, or a wrong &quot;correct&quot; index at any time.
+class QuestionSchemaValidator {
+  QuestionSchemaValidator._();
+
+  /// Same banned patterns the bundled-bank guard tests use: no LaTeX
+  /// markup, no placeholder text, no invented board-year claims.
+  static final RegExp _banned = RegExp(
+    r&#x27;\\begin|\\frac|TODO|FIXME|lorem|placeholder|Board 20[0-9][0-9]&#x27;,
+    caseSensitive: false,
+  );
+
+  /// Validates one MCQ.
+  static QuestionValidation validateMcq(Question q) {
+    final errors = &lt;String&gt;[];
+    final warnings = &lt;String&gt;[];
+
+    final stem = q.questionText.trim();
+    if (stem.isEmpty) errors.add(&#x27;empty question text&#x27;);
+
+    if (q.options.length != 4) {
+      errors.add(&#x27;has ${q.options.length} options, expected 4&#x27;);
+    }
+    final normOpts = [
+      for (final o in q.options) _norm(o),
+    ];
+    if (normOpts.toSet().length != normOpts.length) {
+      errors.add(&#x27;options are not distinct&#x27;);
+    }
+    for (var i = 0; i &lt; q.options.length; i++) {
+      if (q.options[i].trim().isEmpty) errors.add(&#x27;option $i is empty&#x27;);
+    }
+    if (q.correctIndex &lt; 0 || q.correctIndex &gt;= q.options.length) {
+      errors.add(&#x27;correctIndex ${q.correctIndex} out of range&#x27;);
+    }
+    if (q.explanation.trim().isEmpty) {
+      errors.add(&#x27;explanation is empty&#x27;);
+    }
+
+    for (final text in [q.questionText, q.explanation, ...q.options]) {
+      if (_banned.hasMatch(text)) {
+        errors.add(&#x27;banned content (LaTeX/placeholder): ${text.trim().substring(0, text.trim().length &gt; 40 ? 40 : text.trim().length)}…&#x27;);
+        break;
+      }
+    }
+
+    // Answer-sanity heuristic (review item #6, cheap local half): if the
+    // explanation quotes an option&#x27;s wording, it should quote the
+    // correct one — not a distractor.
+    if (!errors.isEmpty) return QuestionValidation(errors: errors);
+    final exp = _norm(q.explanation);
+    if (exp.isNotEmpty) {
+      String? mentionedWrong;
+      bool mentionsCorrect = false;
+      for (var i = 0; i &lt; normOpts.length; i++) {
+        final opt = normOpts[i];
+        if (opt.length &lt; 8) continue; // too short to be a meaningful quote
+        final quoted = exp.contains(opt) || _sharesLongFragment(exp, opt);
+        if (!quoted) continue;
+        if (i == q.correctIndex) {
+          mentionsCorrect = true;
+        } else {
+          mentionedWrong ??= q.options[i].trim();
+        }
+      }
+      if (mentionedWrong != null &amp;&amp; !mentionsCorrect) {
+        warnings.add(
+            &#x27;explanation appears to reference option &quot;${mentionedWrong.length &gt; 40 ? &#x27;${mentionedWrong.substring(0, 40)}…&#x27; : mentionedWrong}&quot; instead of the stored key&#x27;);
+      }
+    }
+    return QuestionValidation(errors: errors, warnings: warnings);
+  }
+
+  /// Validates a batch: per-question checks plus batch-level rules
+  /// (requested count, in-batch duplicates).
+  static List&lt;QuestionValidation&gt; validateBatch(List&lt;Question&gt; questions,
+      {int expectedCount = -1}) {
+    final out = [for (final q in questions) validateMcq(q)];
+    if (expectedCount &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; questions.length != expectedCount) {
+      for (var i = 0; i &lt; out.length; i++) {
+        out[i] = out[i].merged(QuestionValidation(
+            errors:
+                [&#x27;batch has ${questions.length} questions, expected $expectedCount&#x27;]));
+      }
+    }
+    final seen = &lt;String, int&gt;{};
+    for (var i = 0; i &lt; questions.length; i++) {
+      final key = _norm(questions[i].questionText);
+      final first = seen[key];
+      if (first != null) {
+        out[i] = out[i].merged(QuestionValidation(
+            errors: [&#x27;duplicate of question #$${first + 1} in the same batch&#x27;]));
+      } else {
+        seen[key] = i;
+      }
+    }
+    return out;
+  }
+
+  /// True when [hay] contains a word-run of [needle] at least 8 chars —
+  /// catches &quot;option text&quot; quotes that survive light rephrasing.
+  static bool _sharesLongFragment(String hay, String needle) {
+    if (needle.length &lt; 8) return false;
+    final words = needle.split(&#x27; &#x27;).where((w) =&gt; w.length &gt;= 8).toList();
+    for (final w in words) {
+      if (hay.contains(w)) return true;
+    }
+    // Otherwise check the first 12-char run.
+    final run = needle.length &gt;= 12 ? needle.substring(0, 12) : needle;
+    return hay.contains(run);
+  }
+
+  static String _norm(String s) =&gt;
+      s.toLowerCase().replaceAll(RegExp(r&#x27;\s+&#x27;), &#x27; &#x27;).trim();
+}

+<div class="card"><h2 id="h6">lib/services/ai/duplicate_detector.dart<br><button class="copy" onclick="copyFile(6)">Copy this file</button></h2><pre id="f6">import &#x27;../questions_data.dart&#x27;;
+
+/// One near-duplicate finding.
+class DuplicateHit {
+  /// The generated question that looks like a copy.
+  final Question generated;
+  /// The bank question it resembles.
+  final Question source;
+  /// 0.0 (unrelated) … 1.0 (identical after normalization).
+  final double similarity;
+
+  const DuplicateHit(this.generated, this.source, this.similarity);
+}
+
+/// Near-duplicate detection for AI-generated questions (review item #5).
+///
+/// The prompt asking the model to &quot;make different questions every time&quot;
+/// is not enforcement. Before generated questions are accepted they are
+/// compared against the existing bank, previous AI questions and the
+/// current paper — with similarity, not just exact text equality, so
+/// &quot;Photosynthesis occurs mainly in…&quot; vs &quot;Where does photosynthesis
+/// primarily occur?&quot; is caught as effectively the same question.
+class DuplicateDetector {
+  DuplicateDetector._();
+
+  /// Jaccard similarity over normalized word tokens (order-independent,
+  /// so rewording that keeps the words still scores high).
+  static double similarity(String a, String b) {
+    final ta = _tokens(a);
+    final tb = _tokens(b);
+    if (ta.isEmpty || tb.isEmpty) return 0;
+    final inter = ta.intersection(tb).length;
+    final uni = ta.union(tb).length;
+    return uni == 0 ? 0 : inter / uni;
+  }
+
+  /// Two questions are &quot;the same&quot; above this similarity. 0.75 catches
+  /// light rephrasing without flagging two questions that merely share
+  /// the topic&#x27;s vocabulary.
+  static const double defaultThreshold = 0.75;
+
+  static bool isDuplicate(String a, String b,
+      {double threshold = defaultThreshold}) {
+    final na = _norm(a);
+    final nb = _norm(b);
+    if (na.isEmpty) return false;
+    if (na == nb) return true;
+    return similarity(na, nb) &gt;= threshold;
+  }
+
+  /// Compares every generated question against [bank] (existing bank
+  /// rows, previous AI questions, the current paper — caller&#x27;s choice).
+  /// Returns only the hits above [threshold], best match first per
+  /// generated question.
+  static List&lt;DuplicateHit&gt; findDuplicates(
+    List&lt;Question&gt; generated,
+    Iterable&lt;Question&gt; bank, {
+    double threshold = defaultThreshold,
+  }) {
+    final bankList = bank.toList();
+    final hits = &lt;DuplicateHit&gt;[];
+    for (final g in generated) {
+      Question? best;
+      var bestScore = 0.0;
+      for (final b in bankList) {
+        final s = isDuplicateFast(g.questionText, b.questionText, threshold)
+            ? similarity(g.questionText, b.questionText)
+            : 0.0;
+        if (s &gt;= threshold &amp;&amp; s &gt; bestScore) {
+          bestScore = s;
+          best = b;
+        }
+      }
+      if (best != null) {
+        hits.add(DuplicateHit(g, best, bestScore));
+      }
+    }
+    return hits;
+  }
+
+  /// Cheap pre-filter before the Jaccard pass (token-count gate) —
+  /// similarity can only exceed [threshold] when the token sets overlap
+  /// a lot, which is impossible for very different lengths.
+  static bool isDuplicateFast(String a, String b, double threshold) {
+    final ta = _tokens(a);
+    final tb = _tokens(b);
+    if (ta.isEmpty || tb.isEmpty) return false;
+    final minLen = ta.length &lt; tb.length ? ta.length : tb.length;
+    final maxLen = ta.length &gt; tb.length ? ta.length : tb.length;
+    // max(inter) ≤ minLen; need inter/union ≥ t  ⇒  minLen/maxLen ≥ t
+    return minLen / maxLen &gt;= threshold * 0.9;
+  }
+
+  static Set&lt;String&gt; _tokens(String s) =&gt;
+      _norm(s).split(&#x27; &#x27;).where((w) =&gt; w.isNotEmpty).toSet();
+
+  static String _norm(String s) =&gt;
+      s.toLowerCase().replaceAll(RegExp(r&#x27;[^a-z0-9\u0980-\u09FF]+&#x27;), &#x27; &#x27;).trim();
+}

+<div class="card"><h2 id="h9">tool/bank_health.py<br><button class="copy" onclick="copyFile(9)">Copy this file</button></h2><pre id="f9">#!/usr/bin/env python3
+&quot;&quot;&quot;Question Bank Health report (review item #35).
+
+Runs on every CI build and locally (python3 tool/bank_health.py).
+Checks the bundled bank the way a shipping guard should:
+
+  * totals per file / type
+  * missing or out-of-range answer keys
+  * duplicate ids
+  * duplicate question stems (exact, normalized)
+  * invalid options (not 4, not distinct, empty)
+  * empty explanations
+  * subject/chapter distribution (so a lost chapter stands out)
+
+Exit code 0 = bank is healthy (warnings allowed), 1 = hard problems.
+&quot;&quot;&quot;
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import sys
+import collections
+
+ROOT = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), &quot;..&quot;)
+QDIR = os.path.join(ROOT, &quot;assets&quot;, &quot;questions&quot;)
+
+HARD = []
+WARN = []
+
+
+def norm(s: str) -&gt; str:
+    return re.sub(r&quot;\s+&quot;, &quot; &quot;, (s or &quot;&quot;)).strip().lower()
+
+
+def main() -&gt; int:
+    manifest = json.load(open(os.path.join(QDIR, &quot;manifest.json&quot;), encoding=&quot;utf-8&quot;))
+    files = manifest[&quot;files&quot;]
+    if not os.path.isdir(QDIR):
+        print(&quot;bank directory missing:&quot;, QDIR)
+        return 1
+
+    by_id = collections.Counter()
+    by_stem = collections.Counter()
+    total = 0
+    per_file = collections.Counter()
+    per_type = collections.Counter()
+    dist = collections.Counter()
+    empty_chapters = []
+
+    for name in files:
+        path = os.path.join(QDIR, name)
+        rows = json.load(open(path, encoding=&quot;utf-8&quot;))
+        per_file[name] = len(rows)
+        for r in rows:
+            total += 1
+            t = r.get(&quot;type&quot;)
+            per_type[t] += 1
+            qid = r.get(&quot;id&quot;)
+            by_id[qid] += 1
+            payload = r.get(&quot;payload&quot;) or {}
+            if t == &quot;mcq&quot;:
+                opts = payload.get(&quot;options&quot;) or []
+                key = payload.get(&quot;correctIndex&quot;)
+                stem = norm(payload.get(&quot;questionText&quot;))
+                by_stem[(r.get(&quot;subjectId&quot;), t, stem)] += 1
+                if not stem:
+                    HARD.append(f&quot;{qid}: empty question text&quot;)
+                if len(opts) != 4:
+                    HARD.append(f&quot;{qid}: {len(opts)} options (expected 4)&quot;)
+                elif len(set(norm(o) for o in opts)) != 4:
+                    HARD.append(f&quot;{qid}: options not distinct&quot;)
+                if any(norm(o) == &quot;&quot; for o in opts):
+                    HARD.append(f&quot;{qid}: empty option&quot;)
+                if not isinstance(key, int) or not (0 &lt;= key &lt; len(opts)):
+                    HARD.append(f&quot;{qid}: invalid correctIndex {key!r}&quot;)
+                elif not norm(opts[key]):
+                    HARD.append(f&quot;{qid}: correct option is empty&quot;)
+                if norm(payload.get(&quot;explanation&quot;)) == &quot;&quot;:
+                    WARN.append(f&quot;{qid}: empty explanation&quot;)
+                dist[(r.get(&quot;subjectId&quot;), r.get(&quot;chapter&quot;), t)] += 1
+            else:
+                stem = norm(payload.get(&quot;questionText&quot;) or payload.get(&quot;stem&quot;))
+                by_stem[(r.get(&quot;subjectId&quot;), t, stem)] += 1
+                if not stem:
+                    HARD.append(f&quot;{qid}: empty question text&quot;)
+                if t == &quot;saq&quot;:
+                    if norm(payload.get(&quot;answer&quot;)) == &quot;&quot;:
+                        HARD.append(f&quot;{qid}: empty answer&quot;)
+                    if norm(payload.get(&quot;explanation&quot;)) == &quot;&quot;:
+                        WARN.append(f&quot;{qid}: empty explanation&quot;)
+                if t == &quot;cq&quot;:
+                    # The bank legitimately ships two CQ shapes (both
+                    # rendered by paper_pdf.dart, both covered by the
+                    # guard tests): math &quot;solution-check&quot; questions are
+                    # three-part (ক খ গ, marks 2-4-4, no ঘ) and the
+                    # classic creative question is four-part (1-2-3-4).
+                    # Check internal consistency instead of one shape.
+                    for k in (&quot;questionK&quot;, &quot;questionKh&quot;, &quot;questionG&quot;):
+                        if norm(payload.get(k)) == &quot;&quot;:
+                            HARD.append(f&quot;{qid}: empty {k}&quot;)
+                    gh = norm(payload.get(&quot;questionGh&quot;)) != &quot;&quot;
+                    marks = payload.get(&quot;marks&quot;)
+                    if gh:
+                        if marks != [1, 2, 3, 4]:
+                            HARD.append(f&quot;{qid}: 4 parts but marks {marks!r}&quot;)
+                    else:
+                        if marks != [2, 4, 4]:
+                            HARD.append(f&quot;{qid}: 3 parts but marks {marks!r}&quot;)
+            ch = r.get(&quot;chapter&quot;)
+            if not ch:
+                HARD.append(f&quot;{qid}: missing chapter&quot;)
+
+    for qid, n in by_id.items():
+        if n &gt; 1:
+            HARD.append(f&quot;duplicate id: {qid} (x{n})&quot;)
+    for (sub, t, stem), n in by_stem.items():
+        if n &gt; 1 and stem:
+            WARN.append(f&quot;duplicate stem ({sub}, {t}): {stem[:60]!r} (x{n})&quot;)
+
+    # chapter distribution (per subject, MCQs) — a dropped chapter shows up
+    print(&quot;Question Bank Health&quot;)
+    print(&quot;====================&quot;)
+    print(f&quot;total questions: {total}&quot;)
+    for t in sorted(per_type):
+        print(f&quot;  {t}: {per_type[t]}&quot;)
+    print(&quot;\nper file:&quot;)
+    for name in files:
+        want = manifest.get(&quot;counts&quot;, {}).get(name)
+        got = per_file[name]
+        flag = &quot;&quot; if want in (None, got) else f&quot;  &lt;-- manifest says {want}&quot;
+        print(f&quot;  {name}: {got}{flag}&quot;)
+    if manifest.get(&quot;total&quot;) != total:
+        HARD.append(f&quot;manifest total {manifest.get(&#x27;total&#x27;)} != actual {total}&quot;)
+
+    print(&quot;\nsubject / chapter (MCQs):&quot;)
+    by_sub_ch = collections.Counter()
+    for (sub, ch, t), n in dist.items():
+        if t == &quot;mcq&quot; and ch:
+            by_sub_ch[(sub, ch)] += n
+    for (sub, ch), n in sorted(by_sub_ch.items(), key=lambda kv: (kv[0][0] or &quot;&quot;, kv[0][1] or &quot;&quot;)):
+        print(f&quot;  {sub} :: {ch}: {n}&quot;)
+
+    print()
+    if WARN:
+        print(f&quot;warnings ({len(WARN)}):&quot;)
+        for w in WARN[:50]:
+            print(&quot;  -&quot;, w)
+        if len(WARN) &gt; 50:
+            print(f&quot;  ... and {len(WARN) - 50} more&quot;)
+    if HARD:
+        print(f&quot;\nPROBLEMS ({len(HARD)}):&quot;)
+        for h in HARD[:80]:
+            print(&quot;  !&quot;, h)
+        if len(HARD) &gt; 80:
+            print(f&quot;  ... and {len(HARD) - 80} more&quot;)
+        print(&quot;\nBANK UNHEALTHY&quot;)
+        return 1
+    print(&quot;bank healthy ✓&quot; + (f&quot; ({len(WARN)} warnings)&quot; if WARN else &quot;&quot;))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == &quot;__main__&quot;:
+    sys.exit(main())
+</pre></div>

+<div class="card"><h2 id="h12">docs/RLS-CHECKLIST.md<br><button class="copy" onclick="copyFile(12)">Copy this file</button></h2><pre id="f12"># RLS audit checklist (Phase 1, items #3/#4/#6/#7)
+
+~10 minutes in the Supabase dashboard. Three steps, in order.
+
+## 1. Run the hardening migration (once)
+
+1. Open the SQL editor: &lt;https://supabase.com/dashboard/project/vxexidxdoghdmzvkvgqk/sql/new&gt;
+2. Paste the whole file **`supabase/migrations/20260923000001_harden_profiles.sql`**
+3. Press **Run**
+
+What it does: enables RLS on `profiles`, replaces whatever policies exist there
+with the minimal own-row set, and adds a trigger that freezes
+`is_pro` / `pro_until` / `pro_plan` for any write made with a user token.
+Pro activation keeps working — the bKash edge function writes those columns
+with the service-role key, which the trigger lets through (it is the only
+path that may change Pro).
+
+## 2. Run the audit (read-only, any time)
+
+Paste **`supabase/audit_rls.sql`** and Run, then copy the output. Check:
+
+- [ ] Section 1: `profiles`, `questions`, `question_admins` → `rls_enabled = true`
+- [ ] Section 2: `profiles` shows exactly `profiles_select_own`,
+      `profiles_insert_own`, `profiles_update_own` (and nothing permissive
+      like `using (true)`)
+- [ ] Section 3: only your own account is a question admin
+- [ ] Section 4: bypass-RLS roles are Supabase-managed only
+      (`postgres`, `supabase_admin`, `service_role`…) — no custom role
+- [ ] Section 6: the `profiles_protect_pro` trigger exists
+
+## 3. Prove it (optional, 2 minutes)
+
+In the SQL editor, **as your own signed-in session** (not service role), run:
+
+```sql
+update public.profiles set is_pro = true where id = auth.uid();
+```
+
+Expected: the row&#x27;s `is_pro` is still whatever it was before (the trigger
+reverts the change). Then check **Section 5** of the audit output —
+`is_pro` unchanged. That is the attack the migration blocks.
+
+## Keep in mind
+
+- The anon key in `lib/services/supabase_config.dart` is public by design —
+  security depends entirely on RLS, which is why this audit matters.
+- If a step fails, paste the error here; do **not** run anything that
+  deletes data.

+<div class="card"><h2 id="h13">docs/RELEASE-SIGNING.md<br><button class="copy" onclick="copyFile(13)">Copy this file</button></h2><pre id="f13"># Release signing (review item #31)
+
+Your CI is already set up for proper release signing — it only waits for
+the four secrets. Until they exist, every APK is **debug-signed** (works
+on your phone, but must be uninstalled before a signed build can be
+installed over it, and is not Play-Store ready).
+
+## One-time setup (~5 minutes, on any computer)
+
+### 1. Generate the keystore (ONLY ONCE — never lose this file)
+
+```bash
+keytool -genkeypair -v \
+  -keystore release.keystore \
+  -storetype pkcs12 \
+  -alias tutorsdesk \
+  -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10000
+```
+
+- When asked for a &quot;distinguished name&quot;, the organization can be your
+  name; the important fields are the **store password** and the alias
+  (`tutorsdesk`).
+- **Back up `release.keystore` somewhere safe** (password manager,
+  encrypted drive). If it is ever lost, you can never update the app on
+  existing phones — a new key means a fresh install for every user.
+- Do **not** commit it to the repo.
+
+### 2. Base64-encode it
+
+```bash
+# Linux / macOS
+base64 -i release.keystore    # (macOS: base64 -i; Linux: base64 -w0)
+# Windows (PowerShell)
+[Convert]::ToBase64String([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes(&quot;release.keystore&quot;))
+```
+
+Copy the whole single line.
+
+### 3. Add the 4 secrets to the GitHub repo
+
+&lt;https://github.com/subornokhan22-collab/SSC/settings/secrets/actions&gt;
+
+| Secret name                  | Value                          |
+|------------------------------|--------------------------------|
+| `RELEASE_KEYSTORE_BASE64`    | the base64 line from step 2    |
+| `RELEASE_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD`  | the keystore password          |
+| `RELEASE_KEY_ALIAS`          | `tutorsdesk` (your alias)      |
+| `RELEASE_KEY_PASSWORD`       | the key password (usually the same) |
+
+### 4. Push once
+
+The next build signs with the real key. From that point on,
+**uninstall the app once** on each phone and install the new build —
+Android refuses to update an app whose signature changed. Every build
+after that updates normally.
+
+## How CI uses it
+
+`android/app/build.gradle.kts` signs release builds with `release-ci`
+when the keystore + password are present (restored by the workflow from
+`RELEASE_KEYSTORE_BASE64`), and falls back to debug signing otherwise —
+so local development builds keep working with nothing configured.
+
+## Also set (same Secrets page, for Phase 1 AI)
+
+| Secret / location                                   | Value            |
+|-----------------------------------------------------|------------------|
+| Supabase → Edge Functions → Secrets → `GEMINI_API_KEY` | your Gemini key |
+
+(The Supabase edge-function secrets are **not** GitHub secrets — they
+live in &lt;https://supabase.com/dashboard/project/vxexidxdoghdmzvkvgqk/functions&gt;.)
+</pre></div>

+const Map&lt;String, String&gt; _subMap = {
+  &#x27;0&#x27;: &#x27;₀&#x27;, &#x27;1&#x27;: &#x27;₁&#x27;, &#x27;2&#x27;: &#x27;₂&#x27;, &#x27;3&#x27;: &#x27;₃&#x27;, &#x27;4&#x27;: &#x27;₄&#x27;, &#x27;5&#x27;: &#x27;₅&#x27;, &#x27;6&#x27;: &#x27;₆&#x27;,

+  &#x27;a&#x27;: &#x27;ₐ&#x27;, &#x27;e&#x27;: &#x27;ₑ&#x27;, &#x27;h&#x27;: &#x27;ₕ&#x27;, &#x27;i&#x27;: &#x27;ᵢ&#x27;, &#x27;k&#x27;: &#x27;ₖ&#x27;, &#x27;l&#x27;: &#x27;ₗ&#x27;, &#x27;m&#x27;: &#x27;ₘ&#x27;,

+};

+String _mapScript(String group, Map&lt;String, String&gt; map) {
+  final buf = StringBuffer();
+  for (final rune in group.runes) {
+    buf.write(map[String.fromCharCode(rune)] ?? String.fromCharCode(rune));
+  }
+  return buf.toString();
+}

+/// Turns the LaTeX the model sometimes emits (MgCl_2, Mg^{2+},
+/// \rightarrow, \text{...}) into the plain Unicode text the chat
+/// bubble can actually render: MgCl₂, Mg²⁺, →. No-op for normal text.
+String plainifyMath(String text) {
+  if (!text.contains(r&#x27;\&#x27;) &amp;&amp; !text.contains(&#x27;\$&#x27;)) return text;
+  var s = text;
+
+  // \begin{env} ... \end{env} -&gt; drop the tags, keep the content.
+  s = s.replaceAll(RegExp(r&#x27;\\(?:begin|end)\{[^{}]*\}&#x27;), &#x27;&#x27;);
+  s = s.replaceAll(&#x27;&amp;&#x27;, &#x27; &#x27;);
+
+  // \text{...} / \mathrm{...} -&gt; the inner text (repeat for nesting).
+  for (var i = 0; i &lt; 4; i++) {
+    final t = s.replaceAll(RegExp(r&#x27;\\(?:text|textrm|mathrm|mathbf)\{([^{}]*)\}&#x27;), r&#x27;\1&#x27;);
+    if (t == s) break;
+    s = t;
+  }
+  s = s.replaceAll(RegExp(r&#x27;\\(?:left|right)([|.(])?(?![a-zA-Z])&#x27;), r&#x27;\1&#x27;);
+
+  // \frac{a}{b} -&gt; (a)/(b), one level of nested braces allowed
+  for (var i = 0; i &lt; 3; i++) {
+    final t = s.replaceAll(
+        RegExp(r&#x27;\\frac\{((?:[^{}]|\{[^{}]*\})*)\}\{((?:[^{}]|\{[^{}]*\})*)\}&#x27;),
+        r&#x27;(\1)/(\2)&#x27;);
+    if (t == s) break;
+    s = t;
+  }
+
+  // Named commands -&gt; Unicode. Longest keys first so \ne wins over
+  // \neq, \leftarrow over shorter prefixes, etc.
+  final cmdEntries = _latCmds.entries.toList()
+    ..sort((a, b) =&gt; b.key.length.compareTo(a.key.length));
+  for (final e in cmdEntries) {
+    s = s.replaceAll(&#x27;\\${e.key}&#x27;, e.value);
+  }
+
+  // Escapes &amp; spacing.
+  s = s.replaceAll(RegExp(r&#x27;\\[,;:!]&#x27;), &#x27; &#x27;);
+  s = s.replaceAll(r&#x27;\%&#x27;, &#x27;%&#x27;);
+  s = s.replaceAll(r&#x27;\\&#x27;, &#x27;\n&#x27;); // math line break
+  s = s.replaceAll(r&#x27;\$&#x27;, &#x27;&#x27;);
+
+  // Superscripts and subscripts.
+  s = s.replaceAllMapped(RegExp(r&#x27;\^\{([^{}]*)\}&#x27;),
+      (m) =&gt; _mapScript(m.group(1)!, _supMap));
+  s = s.replaceAllMapped(RegExp(r&#x27;\^([0-9+\-])&#x27;),
+      (m) =&gt; _supMap[m.group(1)!] ?? m.group(1)!);
+  s = s.replaceAllMapped(RegExp(r&#x27;_\{([^{}]*)\}&#x27;),
+      (m) =&gt; _mapScript(m.group(1)!, _subMap));
+  s = s.replaceAllMapped(RegExp(r&#x27;_([0-9+\-])&#x27;),
+      (m) =&gt; _subMap[m.group(1)!] ?? m.group(1)!);
+
+  // Leftovers: $ delimiters, braces, unknown commands.
+  s = s.replaceAll(&#x27;\$&#x27;, &#x27;&#x27;);
+  s = s.replaceAll(&#x27;{&#x27;, &#x27;&#x27;).replaceAll(&#x27;}&#x27;, &#x27;&#x27;);
+  s = s.replaceAllMapped(RegExp(r&#x27;\\([a-zA-Z]+)&#x27;), (m) {
+    final c = m.group(1)!;
+    return (c == &#x27;quad&#x27; || c == &#x27;qquad&#x27;) ? &#x27;  &#x27; : &#x27;&#x27;;
+  });
+  s = s.replaceAll(r&#x27;\&#x27;, &#x27;&#x27;);
+
+  s = s.replaceAll(RegExp(r&#x27;\n{3,}&#x27;), &#x27;\n\n&#x27;);
+  return s;
+}

+/// MiMi — the in-app AI assistant.
+///
+/// Answers and solves questions in Bangladesh Education Board style using
+/// the tutor&#x27;s free Gemini API key (stored on the device). Accepts text
+/// plus attachments: photos (with in-app crop), audio and PDFs — each with
+/// a size limit so the model can actually work with them.
+///
+/// UI: a dark &quot;mission control&quot; look — full-width glass bubbles over a
+/// slowly drifting neon backdrop, a glowing thinking orb while MiMi works,
+/// and a rotating glow border while an answer streams in.
+class AiTutorScreen extends StatefulWidget {
+  const AiTutorScreen({super.key});
+
+  @override
+  State&lt;AiTutorScreen&gt; createState() =&gt; _AiTutorScreenState();
+}
+
+// ── attachment limits (kept small so Gemini can read them reliably) ──
+const int kPhotoMaxBytes = 15 * 1024 * 1024; // before crop/resize
+const int kAudioMaxBytes = 5 * 1024 * 1024;
+const int kPdfMaxBytes = 10 * 1024 * 1024;
+const int kTextMaxChars = 4000;
+const int kMaxAttachments = 3;
+
+// ── the dark palette (every colour already exists elsewhere in the app) ─
+const Color _mimiBg = Color(0xFF0B0E17); // same deep navy as the crop screen
+const Color _mimiTeal = Color(0xFF7FE7DC); // bright teal from the crop screen
+const Color _mimiAmber = Color(0xFFFFC93C); // amber from the crop corner ticks
+const Color _mimiText = Color(0xFFE9EDF8);
+
+class _AttMeta {
+  final String kind; // &#x27;photo&#x27; | &#x27;audio&#x27; | &#x27;pdf&#x27;
+  final String label;
+  final String size;
+  const _AttMeta(this.kind, this.label, this.size);
+}
+
+class _ChatMsg {
+  final bool isUser;
+  final String text;
+  final List&lt;_AttMeta&gt; atts;
+  const _ChatMsg({required this.isUser, required this.text, this.atts = const []});
+}
+
+class _Pending {
+  final String kind;
+  final String label;
+  final String mime;
+  final Uint8List bytes;
+  const _Pending(this.kind, this.label, this.mime, this.bytes);
+}

+class _AiTutorScreenState extends State&lt;AiTutorScreen&gt;
+    with TickerProviderStateMixin, WidgetsBindingObserver {
+  static const _keyPref = &#x27;gemini_api_key&#x27;;
+  static const _chatPref = &#x27;boktul_chat_v1&#x27;;
+
+  String? _key;
+  bool _ready = false;
+  final List&lt;_ChatMsg&gt; _msgs = [];
+  final List&lt;_Pending&gt; _pending = [];
+  final TextEditingController _ctrl = TextEditingController();
+  final ScrollController _scroll = ScrollController();
+
+  bool _busy = false;
+  String? _streaming;
+
+  /// Drives the thinking orb, the streaming glow border, the equalizer and
+  /// the caret. Only runs while MiMi is working.
+  late final AnimationController _fx;
+  /// Drives the drifting aurora / star backdrop. Always running (while the
+  /// app is in the foreground).
+  late final AnimationController _bg;
+
+  @override
+  void initState() {
+    super.initState();
+    _fx = AnimationController(vsync: this, duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 2600));
+    _bg = AnimationController(vsync: this, duration: const Duration(seconds: 26))
+      ..repeat();
+    _ctrl.addListener(() {
+      if (mounted) setState(() {});
+    });
+    SystemChrome.setSystemUIOverlayStyle(
+        AppTheme.overlayStyle.copyWith(statusBarIconBrightness: Brightness.light, statusBarColor: Colors.transparent, systemNavigationBarColor: _mimiBg, systemNavigationBarIconBrightness: Brightness.light));
+    WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this);
+    _load();
+  }
+
+  @override
+  void didChangeAppLifecycleState(AppLifecycleState state) {
+    if (state == AppLifecycleState.resumed) {
+      if (!_bg.isAnimating) _bg.repeat();
+      if (_busy &amp;&amp; !_fx.isAnimating) _fx.repeat();
+    } else {
+      _bg.stop();
+      _fx.stop();
+    }
+  }
+
+  @override
+  void dispose() {
+    WidgetsBinding.instance.removeObserver(this);
+    SystemChrome.setSystemUIOverlayStyle(AppTheme.overlayStyle);
+    _fx.dispose();
+    _bg.dispose();
+    _ctrl.dispose();
+    _scroll.dispose();
+    super.dispose();
+  }
+
+  Future&lt;void&gt; _load() async {
+    final p = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
+    final raw = p.getString(_chatPref);
+    if (raw != null) {
+      try {
+        final j = jsonDecode(raw);
+        if (j is List) {
+          for (final m in j) {
+            if (m is Map) {
+              _msgs.add(_ChatMsg(
+                isUser: m[&#x27;r&#x27;] == 1,
+                text: (m[&#x27;t&#x27;] ?? &#x27;&#x27;).toString(),
+                atts: [
+                  for (final a in (m[&#x27;a&#x27;] is List ? m[&#x27;a&#x27;] : const []))
+                    _AttMeta(&#x27;photo&#x27;, a.toString(), &#x27;&#x27;),
+                ].where((a) =&gt; a.label.isNotEmpty).toList(),
+              ));
+            }
+          }
+        }
+      } catch (_) {}
+    }
+    if (!mounted) return;
+    setState(() {
+      _key = (p.getString(_keyPref) ?? &#x27;&#x27;).trim().isEmpty
+          ? null
+          : (p.getString(_keyPref) ?? &#x27;&#x27;).trim();
+      _ready = true;
+    });
+  }
+
+  Future&lt;void&gt; _problem(String title, String message, {String? detail}) =&gt;
+      showProblemDialog(context, title: title, message: message, detail: detail);
+
+  // ── key ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+  /// Re-reads the key after the setup card saves it.
+  Future&lt;void&gt; _reloadKey() async {
+    final p = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
+    final k = (p.getString(_keyPref) ?? &#x27;&#x27;).trim();
+    if (!mounted) return;
+    setState(() =&gt; _key = k.isEmpty ? null : k);
+  }
+
+  /// ⚙ Advanced: store a device Gemini key (fallback for when the
+  /// server key is unavailable). Not required for everyday use.
+  void _openKeyDialog() {
+    showDialog&lt;void&gt;(
+      context: context,
+      builder: (c) =&gt; PopScope(
+        canPop: true,
+        child: AlertDialog(
+          backgroundColor: _mimiBg,
+          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
+          contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
+          content: _SetupCard(onKeySaved: _reloadKey, compact: true),
+        ),
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+
+  // ── attachments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+  Future&lt;void&gt; _openAttachSheet() async {
+    if (_pending.length &gt;= kMaxAttachments) {
+      await _problem(&#x27;Attachment limit&#x27;,
+          &#x27;Up to $kMaxAttachments attachments per question (photo, audio or PDF).&#x27;);
+      return;
+    }
+    final choice = await showModalBottomSheet&lt;String&gt;(
+      context: context,
+      backgroundColor: AppTheme.card,
+      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
+          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(20))),
+      builder: (c) =&gt; SafeArea(
+        child: Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
+          const Padding(
+            padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
+            child: Text(&#x27;Attach to your question&#x27;,
+                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 15, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900)),
+          ),
+          _attachOption(c, Icons.photo_library_rounded, &#x27;Photo&#x27;,
+              &#x27;From gallery — with crop (max 15 MB)&#x27;, &#x27;photo&#x27;, AppTheme.primary),
+          _attachOption(c, Icons.photo_camera_rounded, &#x27;Camera&#x27;,
+              &#x27;Take a photo of the question — with crop&#x27;, &#x27;camera&#x27;, AppTheme.success),
+          _attachOption(c, Icons.record_voice_over_rounded, &#x27;Audio&#x27;,
+              &#x27;Voice note / mp3 / wav / ogg / flac (max 5 MB)&#x27;, &#x27;audio&#x27;, AppTheme.secondary),
+          _attachOption(c, Icons.picture_as_pdf_rounded, &#x27;PDF&#x27;,
+              &#x27;A question paper or book page (max 10 MB)&#x27;, &#x27;pdf&#x27;, AppTheme.accent),
+          const SizedBox(height: 8),
+        ]),
+      ),
+    );
+    if (choice == &#x27;photo&#x27;) await _pickPhoto();
+    if (choice == &#x27;camera&#x27;) await _pickPhoto(fromCamera: true);
+    if (choice == &#x27;audio&#x27;) await _pickAudio();
+    if (choice == &#x27;pdf&#x27;) await _pickPdf();
+  }
+
+  Widget _attachOption(BuildContext c, IconData icon, String title,
+      String sub, String kind, Color color) {
+    return InkWell(
+      onTap: () =&gt; Navigator.pop(c, kind),
+      child: Padding(
+        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 18, vertical: 10),

+          Container(
+            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
+            decoration: BoxDecoration(
+              shape: BoxShape.circle,
+              color: color.withOpacity(.12),
+              border: Border.all(color: color.withOpacity(.4)),
+            ),
+            child: Icon(icon, color: color, size: 22),

+          const SizedBox(width: 13),
+          Expanded(
+            child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
+              Text(title,
+                  style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
+              const SizedBox(height: 2),
+              Text(sub,
+                  style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11.5, color: AppTheme.muted)),
+            ]),
+          ),
+          const Icon(Icons.chevron_right_rounded, color: AppTheme.muted),
+        ]),
+      ),
+    );

+  Future&lt;void&gt; _pickPhoto({bool fromCamera = false}) async {
+    try {
+      final xfile = await ImagePicker().pickImage(
+        source: fromCamera ? ImageSource.camera : ImageSource.gallery,
+        imageQuality: 95,
+        maxWidth: 4096,
+      );
+      if (xfile == null) return;
+      final bytes = await xfile.readAsBytes();
+      if (bytes.length &gt; kPhotoMaxBytes) {
+        await _problem(&#x27;Photo too large&#x27;,
+            &#x27;This photo is ${_fmtBytes(bytes.length)}. The limit is 15 MB so MiMi can read it reliably.&#x27;);
+        return;
+      }
+      await _attachPhoto(bytes);
+    } catch (e) {
+      await _problem(&#x27;Could not open the photo&#x27;, &#x27;$e&#x27;);
+    }
+  }
+
+  /// Pure-Flutter cropper (no native code → no native crash possible).
+  /// &quot;Use as is&quot; / back keeps the original, resized for the API.
+  Future&lt;void&gt; _attachPhoto(Uint8List bytes) async {
+    try {
+      final codec = await ui.instantiateImageCodec(bytes);
+      final frame = await codec.getNextFrame();
+      final cropped = await ImageCropScreen.open(context, frame.image, bytes);
+      if (!mounted) return;
+      final att = cropped ?? await _resizeJpeg(bytes, 1600, 82);
+      setState(() =&gt; _pending
+          .add(_Pending(&#x27;photo&#x27;, &#x27;Photo&#x27;, &#x27;image/jpeg&#x27;, att)));
+    } catch (e) {
+      await _problem(&#x27;Could not open the photo&#x27;, &#x27;$e&#x27;);
+    }
+  }
+
+  Future&lt;void&gt; _pickAudio() async {
+    try {
+      final res = await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(
+          allowedExtensions: [&#x27;mp3&#x27;, &#x27;wav&#x27;, &#x27;ogg&#x27;, &#x27;flac&#x27;, &#x27;aiff&#x27;, &#x27;aif&#x27;]);
+      final f = res?.files.single;
+      if (f == null || f.path == null) return;
+      final bytes = await _readFile(f.path!);
+      final ext = f.name.toLowerCase().split(&#x27;.&#x27;).last;
+      const ok = {
+        &#x27;wav&#x27;: &#x27;audio/wav&#x27;,
+        &#x27;mp3&#x27;: &#x27;audio/mpeg&#x27;,
+        &#x27;ogg&#x27;: &#x27;audio/ogg&#x27;,
+        &#x27;flac&#x27;: &#x27;audio/flac&#x27;,
+        &#x27;aiff&#x27;: &#x27;audio/aiff&#x27;,
+        &#x27;aif&#x27;: &#x27;audio/aiff&#x27;,
+      };
+      final mime = ok[ext];
+      if (mime == null) {
+        await _problem(&#x27;Audio format not supported&#x27;,
+            &#x27;Please use MP3, WAV, OGG or FLAC. Your file was .${ext.isEmpty ? &#x27;unknown&#x27; : ext}.&#x27;);
+        return;
+      }
+      if (bytes.length &gt; kAudioMaxBytes) {
+        await _problem(&#x27;Audio too long&#x27;,
+            &#x27;This audio is ${_fmtBytes(bytes.length)} — the limit is 5 MB (roughly one minute) so MiMi can listen and answer.&#x27;);
+        return;
+      }
+      if (!mounted) return; // picker + file read can outlive the screen
+      setState(() =&gt; _pending
+          .add(_Pending(&#x27;audio&#x27;, f.name, mime, bytes)));
+    } catch (e) {
+      await _problem(&#x27;Could not open the audio file&#x27;, &#x27;$e&#x27;);
+    }
+  }
+
+  Future&lt;void&gt; _pickPdf() async {
+    try {
+      final res =
+          await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(allowedExtensions: [&#x27;pdf&#x27;]);
+      final f = res?.files.single;
+      if (f == null || f.path == null) return;
+      final bytes = await _readFile(f.path!);
+      if (bytes.length &gt; kPdfMaxBytes) {
+        await _problem(&#x27;PDF too large&#x27;,
+            &#x27;This PDF is ${_fmtBytes(bytes.length)} — the limit is 10 MB. Export only the pages you need.&#x27;);
+        return;
+      }
+      if (!mounted) return; // picker + file read can outlive the screen
+      setState(() =&gt; _pending
+          .add(_Pending(&#x27;pdf&#x27;, f.name, &#x27;application/pdf&#x27;, bytes)));
+    } catch (e) {
+      await _problem(&#x27;Could not open the PDF&#x27;, &#x27;$e&#x27;);
+    }
+  }
+
+  Future&lt;Uint8List&gt; _readFile(String path) async {
+    final f = File(path);
+    if (await f.length() &gt; 40 * 1024 * 1024) {
+      throw Exception(&#x27;file is larger than 40 MB&#x27;);
+    }
+    return f.readAsBytesSync();
+  }
+
+  /// Scales a photo down to at most [maxSide] px and re-encodes as JPEG,
+  /// keeping the payload small enough for the model. Pure Dart (the engine
+  /// no longer JPEG-encodes raw images).
+  Future&lt;Uint8List&gt; _resizeJpeg(Uint8List bytes, int maxSide, int quality) async {
+    try {
+      final source = img.decodeImage(bytes);
+      if (source == null) return bytes;
+      final longest = math.max(source.width, source.height);
+      if (longest &lt;= maxSide) return bytes;
+      final out = img.copyResize(
+        source,
+        width: (source.width * maxSide / longest).round(),
+        height: (source.height * maxSide / longest).round(),
+        interpolation: img.Interpolation.cubic,
+      );
+      return Uint8List.fromList(img.encodeJpg(out, quality: quality));
+    } catch (_) {
+      return bytes;
+    }
+  }
+
+  static String _fmtBytes(int n) {
+    if (n &lt; 1024 * 1024) return &#x27;${(n / 1024).round()} KB&#x27;;
+    return &#x27;${(n / (1024 * 1024)).toStringAsFixed(1)} MB&#x27;;
+  }
+
+  // ── send ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+  Future&lt;void&gt; _send() async {
+    if (_busy) return;
+    final text = _ctrl.text.trim();
+    if (text.length &gt; kTextMaxChars) {
+      await _problem(&#x27;Message too long&#x27;,
+          &#x27;Your message is more than $kTextMaxChars characters — keep it under the limit.&#x27;);
+      return;
+    }
+    if (text.isEmpty &amp;&amp; _pending.isEmpty) return;
+    // No key gate (review item #1): the server carries the Gemini key;
+    // a device key, if stored, is only a fallback (_answer routes it).
+    final atts = List&lt;_Pending&gt;.of(_pending);
+    final attMeta = [
+      for (final a in atts)
+        _AttMeta(a.kind, a.label, _fmtBytes(a.bytes.length)),
+    ];
+    final attachments = [for (final a in atts) GeminiAttachment(a.mime, a.bytes)];
+    setState(() {
+      _ctrl.clear();
+      _pending.clear();
+      _msgs.add(_ChatMsg(isUser: true, text: text, atts: attMeta));
+      _busy = true;
+      _streaming = &#x27;&#x27;;
+    });
+    if (!_fx.isAnimating) _fx.repeat();
+    _scrollToEnd();
+
+    // History: the last 8 turns, text-only (attachments live in the
+    // current turn only — that is what the model should solve).
+    final prev = _msgs.length &gt; 1
+        ? _msgs.sublist(0, _msgs.length - 1)
+        : const &lt;_ChatMsg&gt;[];
+    final history = [
+      for (final m in prev.reversed.take(8))
+        {
+          &#x27;role&#x27;: m.isUser ? &#x27;user&#x27; : &#x27;model&#x27;,
+          &#x27;text&#x27;: m.text.isEmpty &amp;&amp; m.atts.isNotEmpty
+              ? &#x27;[attachment: ${m.atts.map((a) =&gt; a.kind).join(&#x27;, &#x27;)}]&#x27;
+              : m.text,
+        },
+    ].reversed.toList();
+
+    // Paint the first frame so the loading state is visible before the
+    // (slow) network work starts.
+    await SchedulerBinding.instance.endOfFrame;
+    try {
+      final onChunk = (String chunk) {
+        if (!mounted) return;
+        setState(() =&gt; _streaming = (_streaming ?? &#x27;&#x27;) + chunk);
+        _scrollToEnd();
+      };
+      final answer = await _answer(text, history, attachments, onChunk);
+      if (!mounted) return;
+      setState(() {
+        _msgs.add(_ChatMsg(isUser: false, text: answer));
+        _busy = false;
+        _streaming = null;
+      });
+      _fx.stop();
+      await _persist();
+      _scrollToEnd();
+    } on GeminiException catch (e) {
+      if (!mounted) return;
+      setState(() {
+        _busy = false;
+        _streaming = null;
+      });
+      _fx.stop();
+      await _problem(&#x27;MiMi could not answer&#x27;, e.message);
+    } catch (e) {
+      if (!mounted) return;
+      setState(() {
+        _busy = false;
+        _streaming = null;
+      });
+      _fx.stop();
+      await _problem(&#x27;Something went wrong&#x27;, &#x27;$e&#x27;);
+    }
+  }
+
+  /// Server-first routing (review item #1):
+  ///   1. signed in + payload fits the edge function → server key
+  ///   2. server not configured / signed out / payload too large +
+  ///      a device key is stored → device key
+  ///   3. otherwise → an actionable error (sign in, or add a device key
+  ///      via the ⚙ button in the app bar)
+  Future&lt;String&gt; _answer(
+    String userText,
+    List&lt;Map&lt;String, String&gt;&gt; history,
+    List&lt;GeminiAttachment&gt; attachments,
+    void Function(String chunk) onChunk,
+  ) async {
+    final token = AuthService.currentUserToken;
+    final fits =
+        GeminiClient.fitsServerPath(userText: userText, attachments: attachments);
+    if (token != null &amp;&amp; fits) {
+      try {
+        return await GeminiClient.chatViaServer(
+          accessToken: token,
+          systemPrompt: kMimiSystemPrompt,
+          history: history,
+          userText: userText,
+          attachments: attachments,
+          onChunk: onChunk,
+        );
+      } on GeminiException catch (e) {
+        final key = _key;
+        if (key == null) {
+          if (e.code == &#x27;NOT_CONFIGURED&#x27;) {
+            throw const GeminiException(
+                &#x27;MiMi is not set up yet — the server AI key (GEMINI_API_KEY) is missing, and no device key is stored. Ask the app owner to set it in Supabase, or add a device key via the ⚙ button above.&#x27;);
+          }
+          rethrow;
+        }
+        // Server hiccup (quota, network, not configured) — the stored
+        // device key keeps MiMi working.
+        if (!(e.code == &#x27;NOT_CONFIGURED&#x27; ||
+            e.code == &#x27;UNAUTHORIZED&#x27; ||
+            e.code == &#x27;QUOTA&#x27; ||
+            e.code == &#x27;KEY_INVALID&#x27; ||
+            e.code == &#x27;GEMINI_ERROR&#x27;)) {
+          rethrow; // e.g. safety block — same result on the device key
+        }
+      }
+    }
+    final key = _key;
+    if (key == null) {
+      if (!fits) {
+        throw const GeminiException(
+            &#x27;This attachment is too large for the server AI. Use a smaller file, or add a device key via the ⚙ button above.&#x27;);
+      }
+      if (token == null) {
+        throw const GeminiException(
+            &#x27;Sign in with your Tutor\u2019s Desk account to use MiMi — or add a device key via the ⚙ button above.&#x27;);
+      }
+      throw const GeminiException(
+          &#x27;The server AI key is not configured yet. Ask the app owner to set GEMINI_API_KEY in Supabase — or add a device key via the ⚙ button above.&#x27;);
+    }
+    return GeminiClient.chat(
+      apiKey: key,
+      systemPrompt: kMimiSystemPrompt,
+      history: history,
+      userText: userText,
+      attachments: attachments,
+      onChunk: onChunk,
+    );
+  }
+
+  void _scrollToEnd() {
+    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
+      if (_scroll.hasClients) {
+        _scroll.jumpTo(_scroll.position.maxScrollExtent);
+      }
+    });
+  }
+
+  Future&lt;void&gt; _persist() async {
+    final p = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
+    final start = _msgs.length &gt; 40 ? _msgs.length - 40 : 0;
+    final list = [
+      for (final m in _msgs.sublist(start))
+        {
+          &#x27;r&#x27;: m.isUser ? 1 : 0,
+          &#x27;t&#x27;: m.text.length &gt; 4000 ? m.text.substring(0, 4000) : m.text,
+          &#x27;a&#x27;: [for (final a in m.atts) &#x27;${a.kind} • ${a.label}${a.size.isEmpty ? &#x27;&#x27; : &#x27; • ${a.size}&#x27;}&#x27;],
+        },
+    ];
+    await p.setString(_chatPref, jsonEncode(list));
+  }
+
+  Future&lt;void&gt; _clearChat() async {
+    final ok = await showDialog&lt;bool&gt;(
+      context: context,
+      builder: (c) =&gt; AlertDialog(
+        title: const Text(&#x27;Clear the conversation?&#x27;),
+        content: const Text(&#x27;This removes the chat from this phone. Your key stays saved.&#x27;),
+        actions: [
+          TextButton(
+              onPressed: () =&gt; Navigator.pop(c, false),
+              child: const Text(&#x27;Keep&#x27;)),
+          FilledButton(
+              onPressed: () =&gt; Navigator.pop(c, true),
+              child: const Text(&#x27;Clear&#x27;)),
+        ],
+      ),
+    );
+    if (ok != true || !mounted) return;
+    final p = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
+    await p.remove(_chatPref);
+    setState(() =&gt; _msgs.clear());
+  }

+// ── backdrop: aurora blobs, star field, fine grid, slow scan band ─────
+
+class _MimiBackdrop extends StatelessWidget {
+  final AnimationController controller;
+  final bool visible;
+  const _MimiBackdrop({required this.controller, required this.visible});
+
+  static final List&lt;Offset&gt; _stars = [];
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    if (_stars.isEmpty) {
+      final rnd = math.Random(7);
+      for (var i = 0; i &lt; 46; i++) {
+        _stars.add(Offset(rnd.nextDouble(), rnd.nextDouble()));
+      }
+    }
+    if (!visible) {
+      return const DecoratedBox(
+          decoration: BoxDecoration(color: _mimiBg));
+    }
+    return RepaintBoundary(
+      child: ColoredBox(
+        color: _mimiBg,
+        child: AnimatedBuilder(
+          animation: controller,
+          builder: (_, __) =&gt; CustomPaint(
+              painter: _MimiScenePainter(controller.value, _stars)),
+        ),
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+}
+
+class _MimiScenePainter extends CustomPainter {
+  final double t;
+  final List&lt;Offset&gt; stars;
+  _MimiScenePainter(this.t, this.stars);
+
+  void _blob(Canvas canvas, Offset c, double r, Color color) {
+    canvas.drawCircle(
+      c,
+      r,
+      Paint()
+        ..shader = ui.Gradient.radial(
+            c,
+            r,
+            [color, color.withOpacity(0)],
+            const [0.0, 1.0],
+            ui.TileMode.clamp),
+    );
+  }
+
+  @override
+  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
+    final w = size.width, h = size.height;
+    final drift = t * 2 * math.pi;
+
+    // Aurora blobs drifting slowly.
+    _blob(canvas,
+        Offset(w * (.18 + .06 * math.sin(drift)), h * (.16 + .05 * math.cos(drift))),
+        w * .62, AppTheme.primary.withOpacity(.20));
+    _blob(canvas,
+        Offset(w * (.86 + .05 * math.cos(drift * 1.3)), h * (.58 + .07 * math.sin(drift * .8))),
+        w * .55, _mimiTeal.withOpacity(.11));
+    _blob(canvas,
+        Offset(w * (.5 + .08 * math.sin(drift * .7)), h * 1.02),
+        w * .7, AppTheme.primaryDark.withOpacity(.34));
+
+    // Fine grid.
+    final grid = Paint()
+      ..strokeWidth = 1
+      ..color = Colors.white.withOpacity(.028);
+    const step = 46.0;
+    for (double x = 0; x &lt; w; x += step) {
+      canvas.drawLine(Offset(x, 0), Offset(x, h), grid);
+    }
+    for (double y = 0; y &lt; h; y += step) {
+      canvas.drawLine(Offset(0, y), Offset(w, y), grid);
+    }
+
+    // Twinkling stars.
+    for (var i = 0; i &lt; stars.length; i++) {
+      final a = .12 + .22 * math.sin(drift * 2 + i * 1.7).abs();
+      canvas.drawCircle(
+        Offset(stars[i].dx * w, stars[i].dy * h),
+        0.8 + (i % 3) * .45,
+        Paint()..color = Colors.white.withOpacity(a),
+      );
+    }
+
+    // A slow scan band sweeping down — mission-control feel.
+    final bandY = ((t * 1.25) % 1.3) * h - h * .15;
+    canvas.drawRect(
+      Rect.fromLTWH(0, bandY, w, h * .16),
+      Paint()
+        ..shader = ui.Gradient.linear(
+            Offset(0, bandY),
+            Offset(0, bandY + h * .16),
+            [Colors.white.withOpacity(0), Colors.white.withOpacity(.03), Colors.white.withOpacity(0)]),
+    );
+  }
+
+  @override
+  bool shouldRepaint(_MimiScenePainter old) =&gt; old.t != t;
+}
+
+// ── orb energy arcs ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+class _OrbArcsPainter extends CustomPainter {
+  final double t;
+  _OrbArcsPainter(this.t);
+
+  @override
+  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
+    final c = size.center(Offset.zero);
+    final r = size.width / 2 - 2.5;
+    final rect = Rect.fromCircle(center: c, radius: r);
+
+    canvas.drawCircle(
+        c,
+        r,
+        Paint()
+          ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
+          ..strokeWidth = 1
+          ..color = Colors.white.withOpacity(.14));
+
+    final a1 = Paint()
+      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
+      ..strokeWidth = 2.6
+      ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.round
+      ..color = AppTheme.primary;
+    canvas.drawArc(rect, t * 2 * math.pi, 1.15, false, a1);
+
+    final a2 = Paint()
+      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
+      ..strokeWidth = 2
+      ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.round
+      ..color = _mimiTeal;
+    canvas.drawArc(rect, math.pi - t * 2 * math.pi * .83, .75, false, a2);
+
+    // A tiny comet dot riding the primary arc.
+    final ang = t * 2 * math.pi + 1.15;
+    canvas.drawCircle(
+      c + Offset(math.cos(ang), math.sin(ang)) * r,
+      2.2,
+      Paint()..color = _mimiTeal,
+    );
+  }
+
+  @override
+  bool shouldRepaint(_OrbArcsPainter old) =&gt; old.t != t;
+}
+
+// ── rotating neon border for the streaming bubble ─────────────────────
+
+class _GlowBorderPainter extends CustomPainter {
+  final double t;
+  _GlowBorderPainter(this.t);
+
+  @override
+  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
+    const r = 16.0;
+    final rect = Rect.fromLTWH(1, 1, size.width - 2, size.height - 2);
+    final border = RRect.fromRectAndRadius(rect, const Radius.circular(r));
+    final c = Offset(rect.left + rect.width / 2, rect.top + rect.height / 2);
+    final reach = (size.width + size.height) / 2;
+    final ang = t * 2 * math.pi;
+    final b = c + Offset(math.cos(ang), math.sin(ang)) * reach;
+    final e = c - Offset(math.cos(ang), math.sin(ang)) * reach;
+
+    // Soft outer glow.
+    canvas.drawRRect(
+      border,
+      Paint()
+        ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
+        ..strokeWidth = 5
+        ..color = AppTheme.primary.withOpacity(.16),
+    );
+
+    // Rotating 4-stop neon gradient line.
+    canvas.drawRRect(
+      border,
+      Paint()
+        ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
+        ..strokeWidth = 1.6
+        ..shader = ui.Gradient.linear(b, e, const [
+          AppTheme.primary,
+          _mimiTeal,
+          _mimiAmber,
+          AppTheme.primary,
+        ]),
+    );
+  }
+
+  @override
+  bool shouldRepaint(_GlowBorderPainter old) =&gt; old.t != t;
+}

+      showProblemDialog(context, title: title, message: message, detail: detail);

+  /// Primary capture path: Google&#x27;s ML Kit document scanner — live corner
+  /// tracking, auto-capture and a crop step, all inside Google&#x27;s own
+  /// scanner UI. It hands back an already-rectified page, so the OMR read
+  /// only has to find the four corner marks on a straight sheet (or none
+  /// at all — a markless page aligns on its own edges).
+  ///
+  /// The scanner UI and models live in an installable Google Play
+  /// services &quot;module&quot;, so the phone is asked about it before launch and
+  /// every failure mode is explained instead of crashing the native side:
+  ///   ready            → launch the scanner
+  ///   downloadable     → offer the one-time download
+  ///   no scanner API   → Play services update dialog
+  ///
+  /// filter mode (not full): full mode additionally downloads Google&#x27;s
+  /// stain/finger-cleaning ML models from Play services — an extra
+  /// failure point for clean printed OMR sheets that never use it.
+  Future&lt;void&gt; _openCamera() async {
+    if (_key.any((k) =&gt; k &lt; 0)) {
+      await _problem(&#x27;Answer key incomplete&#x27;, &#x27;Complete the answer key first — or tap &quot;Use saved paper&quot;.&#x27;);
+      return;
+    }
+    final (status, statusError) = await _scannerModuleStatus();
+    if (status == -2) {
+      // The scanner client could not even be constructed on this phone.
+      // Show the installed Play services version and the exact error so
+      // the cause is visible, not guessed.
+      final v = await _gmsVersion();
+      final version = v &gt; 0 ? &#x27; (version ${_fmtGmsVersion(v)})&#x27; : &#x27;&#x27;;
+      await _googleScannerUnavailable(
+          &#x27;The Google scanner could not be initialized on this phone&#x27;
+          &#x27;$version.&#x27;,
+          detail: statusError ?? &#x27;The scanner client failed to construct.&#x27;);
+      return;
+    }
+    if (status == 0) {
+      // The scanner module is not on this phone yet — offer the
+      // one-time download before launching.
+      final download = await _offerScannerModuleDownload();
+      if (download != true) return; // in-app camera chosen / cancelled
+    }
+    try {
+      final scanner = DocumentScanner(
+        options: DocumentScannerOptions(
+          documentFormats: {DocumentFormat.jpeg},
+          mode: ScannerMode.filter,
+          pageLimit: 1,
+          isGalleryImport: false,
+        ),
+      );
+      try {
+        final result = await scanner.scanDocument();
+        final images = result.images;
+        if (images == null || images.isEmpty) return; // cancelled
+        // The page comes back straight and cropped to the sheet&#x27;s
+        // edges — the scan may anchor on the page boundary when the
+        // sheet has no (or too few) printed corner marks.
+        await _loadAndScan(images.first, rectified: true);
+      } finally {
+        await scanner.close();
+      }
+    } catch (e) {
+      if (!mounted) return;
+      final why = e.toString().replaceFirst(&#x27;PlatformException(&#x27;, &#x27;&#x27;);
+      await _googleScannerUnavailable(
+          &#x27;It could not start on this phone. Updating Google Play &#x27;
+          &#x27;services usually fixes this.&#x27;,
+          detail: why);
+    }
+  }
+
+  /// Google scanner module status on this phone: 1 = ready, 0 =
+  /// downloadable from Play services, -1 = unknown (query failed — try
+  /// the launch anyway and let the real error surface), -2 = the scanner
+  /// client could not be constructed. The second value carries the
+  /// underlying error text when there is one.
+  Future&lt;(int, String?)&gt; _scannerModuleStatus() async {
+    try {
+      final m = await _appChannel.invokeMethod&lt;dynamic&gt;(&#x27;scannerModuleStatus&#x27;);
+      if (m is Map) {
+        return ((m[&#x27;status&#x27;] as int?) ?? -1, m[&#x27;error&#x27;] as String?);
+      }
+      return (-1, null);
+    } catch (_) {
+      return (-1, null);
+    }
+  }
+
+  /// Installed Play services version code (0 = none installed).
+  Future&lt;int&gt; _gmsVersion() async {
+    try {
+      final v = await _appChannel.invokeMethod&lt;int&gt;(&#x27;gmsVersion&#x27;);
+      return v ?? 0;
+    } catch (_) {
+      return 0;
+    }
+  }
+
+  /// Best-effort human form of a Play services version code
+  /// (e.g. 233119325 → &quot;23.31.19 (build 325)&quot;).
+  static String _fmtGmsVersion(int v) {
+    final s = v.toString();
+    if (s.length == 9) {
+      return &#x27;${s.substring(0, 2)}.${s.substring(2, 4)}.${s.substring(4, 6)}&#x27;
+          &#x27; (build ${s.substring(6)})&#x27;;
+    }
+    if (s.length == 8) {
+      return &#x27;${s.substring(0, 2)}.${s.substring(2, 4)}.${s.substring(4, 8)}&#x27;;
+    }
+    return s;
+  }

+  /// Asks to download the scanner module from Play services; returns
+  /// true only when the module is ready afterwards (downloaded, or
+  /// already there). Anything else means &quot;do not launch the scanner&quot;.
+  Future&lt;bool?&gt; _offerScannerModuleDownload() async {
+    if (!mounted) return null;
+    final proceed = await showDialog&lt;bool&gt;(
+      context: context,
+      barrierDismissible: false,
+      builder: (_) =&gt; AlertDialog(
+        title: const Text(&#x27;Download scanner module&#x27;),
+        content: const Text(
+            &#x27;The Google scanner keeps its scanning module inside Google &#x27;
+            &#x27;Play services, and this phone does not have it yet. &#x27;
+            &#x27;Downloading it is a one-time step of a few megabytes.&#x27;),
+        actions: [
+          TextButton(
+            onPressed: () =&gt; Navigator.of(context).pop(false),
+            child: const Text(&#x27;Use in-app camera&#x27;),

+            onPressed: () =&gt; Navigator.of(context).pop(true),
+            child: const Text(&#x27;Download&#x27;),
+          ),
+        ],
+      ),
+    );
+    if (proceed != true) return proceed;
+    if (!mounted) return null;
+    // Busy dialog for the download; PopScope keeps the back button from
+    // dismissing it mid-download.
+    showDialog&lt;void&gt;(
+      context: context,
+      barrierDismissible: false,
+      builder: (_) =&gt; PopScope(
+        canPop: false,
+        child: const AlertDialog(
+          title: Text(&#x27;Downloading scanner…&#x27;),
+          content: Row(children: [
+            SizedBox(
+                width: 20,
+                height: 20,
+                child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2)),
+            SizedBox(width: 12),
+            Expanded(
+                child:
+                    Text(&#x27;This can take a moment on slow connections.&#x27;)),
+          ]),
+        ),
+      ),
+    );
+    bool ok;
+    String? failedWhy;
+    try {
+      final r = await _appChannel.invokeMethod&lt;int&gt;(&#x27;installScannerModule&#x27;);
+      ok = r == 0 || r == 1; // already installed, or downloaded
+    } catch (e) {

+      failedWhy = e.toString().replaceFirst(&#x27;PlatformException(&#x27;, &#x27;&#x27;);
+    }
+    if (mounted) Navigator.of(context).pop(); // busy dialog
+    if (!ok) {
+      await _googleScannerUnavailable(
+          &#x27;The scanner module could not be downloaded from Play services.&#x27;,
+          detail: failedWhy);

+    }
+    return true;
+  }

+  /// Shown when the Google scanner cannot start: offers the Play Store
